or: Deus, qui beátos Mártyres tuos Fabiánum atque Sebastiánum virtúte constántiæ in passióne roborásti: ex eórum nobis imitatióne tríbue, pro amóre tuo próspera mundi despícere; et nulla ejus advérsa formidáre: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

O God, who strengthened Your blessed martyrs Fabian and Sebastian with the power of constancy in their passion, grant us by their example, for love of You, to despise the prosperity of the world and to fear none of its adversities; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Accépta sit in conspéctu tuo, Dómine, nostræ devotiónis oblátio, et eórum nobis fiat supplicatióne salutáris, pro quorum solemnitáte defértur. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

May the offering of our devotion be acceptable in Your sight, O Lord, and may it become saving for us through the supplication of those on whose feast it is offered; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Sacro múnere satiáti, súpplices te Dómine deprecámur: ut quod débitæ servitútis celebrámus offício; intercedéntibus beátis Martýribus tuis Fabiáno atque Sebastiáno, salvatiónis tuæ sentiámus augméntum: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Filled with the sacred gift, we humbly pray You, O Lord, that what we celebrate in the office of the service we owe, we may, by the intercession of Your blessed martyrs Fabian and Sebastian, feel as an increase of Your salvation; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Deus, qui beátum Matthíam Apostolórum tuórum collégio sociásti; tríbue quǽsumus, ut ejus interventióne, tuæ circa nos pietátis semper víscera sentiámus: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

O God, who joined blessed Matthias to the company of Your Apostles, grant, we beseech You, that by his intercession we may ever feel the tenderness of Your love towards us; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Deus, qui proditóris apóstatæ ruínam, ne Apostolórum tuórum númerus sacrátus perfectióne caréret, beáti Matthíæ electióne supplésti, præséntia múnera sanctífica: ut ea nos grátiæ tuæ virtúte confírment. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

O God, who by the election of blessed Matthias made good the fall of the apostate traitor, so that the sacred number of Your Apostles should not lack its completeness, sanctify these present gifts, that by them we may be strengthened through the power of Your grace; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Præsta, quǽsumus omnípotens et miséricors Deus: ut per hæc sancta, quæ súmpsimus; interveniénte beáto Matthía Apóstolo tuo, véniam consequámur et pacem: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Grant, we beseech You, almighty and merciful God, that through these holy things which we have received, by the intercession of blessed Matthias Your Apostle, we may obtain pardon and peace; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Beáti Patriárchæ Joseph, sanctíssimæ Genitrícis tuæ sponsi, quǽsumus Dómine, méritis adjuvémur: ut quod possibílitas nostra non óbtinet; ejus nobis intercessióne donétur: Qui vivis et regnas cum Deo Patre, in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

May we be helped, we beseech You, O Lord, by the merits of the blessed Patriarch Joseph, the spouse of Your most holy Mother, that what our own power cannot obtain may be given us by his intercession; who live and reign with God the Father, in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Débitum tibi, Dómine, nostræ réddimus servitútis, supplíciter exorántes: ut suffrágiis beáti Joseph sponsi Genitrícis Fílii tui Jesu Christi Dómini nostri, in nobis tua múnera tueáris; ob cujus venerándam festivitátem, laudis tibi hóstias immolámus. Per eúndem Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum Fílium tuum, qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

We render You, O Lord, the debt of our service, humbly beseeching You that by the prayers of blessed Joseph, spouse of the Mother of Your Son Jesus Christ our Lord, You may guard Your gifts in us, on whose venerable feast we offer You sacrifices of praise; through the same Jesus Christ, Your Son, our Lord, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Sit nobis, quǽsumus Dómine, per hæc sancta, quæ súmpsimus, beatíssimi Joseph Patriárchæ solémnitas, præsídium salutáre; qui pretiósæ sponsæ suæ Vírginis matris Fílium in præsépio méruit adoráre Dóminum nostrum Jesum Christum Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

May the feast of the most blessed Patriarch Joseph, we beseech You, O Lord, be to us through these holy things which we have received a saving protection, he who was found worthy to adore in the manger the Son of his precious spouse the Virgin Mother, our Lord Jesus Christ Your Son; who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Omnípotens sempitérne Deus, cui Angelórum míllia minístrant: præsta, quǽsumus, ut qui beátum Gabriélem Archángelum humánæ restauratiónis præcípuum minístrum venerámur in terris; ejúsdem suffrágiis fructum nostræ redemptiónis consequámur in cælis: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Almighty and everlasting God, whom thousands of Angels serve, grant, we beseech You, that we who venerate on earth blessed Gabriel the Archangel, the chief minister of man's restoration, may by his prayers obtain in heaven the fruit of our redemption; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Accéptum fiat in conspéctu tuo, Dómine, nostræ servitútis munus, et beáti Archángeli Gabriélis orátio: ut a nobis venerátus in terris, sit apud te advocátus in cælis. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

May the gift of our service be acceptable in Your sight, O Lord, together with the prayer of blessed Gabriel the Archangel, that he who is venerated by us on earth may be our advocate with You in heaven; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Córporis tui et Sánguinis sumptis mystériis, tuam Dómine Deus noster deprecámur cleméntiam: ut sicut Gabriéle nuntiánte, incarnatiónem tuam cognóvimus; ita ipso adjuvánte, incarnatiónis ejúsdem benefícia consequámur: Qui vivis et regnas cum Deo Patre, in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Having received the mysteries of Your Body and Blood, we entreat Your mercy, O Lord our God, that, as by the message of Gabriel we have known Your incarnation, so by his help we may obtain the benefits of that same incarnation; who live and reign with God the Father, in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Deus, qui beátum Marcum Evangelístam tuum, Evangélicæ prædicatiónis grátia sublimásti: tríbue, quǽsumus, ejus nos semper et eruditióne profícere; et oratióne deféndi: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

O God, who exalted blessed Mark, Your Evangelist, by the grace of preaching the Gospel, grant, we beseech You, that we may ever profit by his teaching and be defended by his prayer; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Beáti Marci Evangelístæ tui solemnitáte tibi múnera deferéntes, quǽsumus Dómine, ut sicut illum prædicátio Evangélica fecit gloriósum, ita nos ejus intercéssio, et verbo, et ópere tibi reddat accéptos. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Bringing You gifts on the feast of blessed Mark, Your Evangelist, we beseech You, O Lord, that, as the preaching of the Gospel made him glorious, so his intercession may make us acceptable to You in word and deed; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Pasti cibo spiritális alimóniæ, quǽsumus Dómine Deus noster: ut quod mystério frequentámus; intercedénte beáto Marco Evangelísta, plena veritáte consequámur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Fed with the food of spiritual nourishment, we beseech You, O Lord our God, that what we often receive in mystery we may, by the intercession of blessed Mark the Evangelist, obtain in the fullness of truth; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Omnípotens sempitérne Deus, qui hujus diéi venerándam sanctámque lætítiam in beáti Apóstoli tui Bartholomǽi festivitáte tribuísti: da Ecclésiæ tuæ, quǽsumus, et amáre quod crédidit; et prædicáre quod dócuit: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Almighty and everlasting God, who have given us the holy and venerable joy of this day in the feast of blessed Bartholomew Your Apostle, grant to Your Church, we beseech You, both to love what he believed and to preach what he taught; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Beáti Apóstoli tui Bartholomǽi solémnia recenséntes, quǽsumus Dómine, ut ejus auxílio tua benefícia capiámus, pro quo tibi laudis hóstias immolámus. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Keeping the feast of blessed Bartholomew Your Apostle, we beseech You, O Lord, that we may receive Your benefits by his help, for whom we offer You sacrifices of praise; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Súmpsimus, Dómine, pignus salútis ætérnæ, celebrántes beáti Apóstoli tui Bartholomǽi votíva solémnia; ut perpétua mérita venerántes, ad vitam nutriámur ætérnam: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

We have received, O Lord, the pledge of eternal salvation, celebrating the feast of blessed Bartholomew Your Apostle, that, venerating his everlasting merits, we may be nourished unto eternal life; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Deus, qui beátum Ludovícum Confessórem tuum de terréno regno ad cæléstis regni glóriam transtulísti: ejus, quǽsumus, méritis et intercessióne; Regis regum Jesu Christi Fílii tui fácias nos esse consórtes: Qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

O God, who brought blessed Louis, Your confessor, from an earthly kingdom to the glory of the heavenly kingdom, make us, we beseech You, by his merits and intercession, to share the kingdom of the King of kings, Jesus Christ Your Son; who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Múnera, quǽsumus Dómine, obláta sanctífica: ut intercessióne beáti Ludovíci Confessóris tui, nobis regni cæléstis præparent mansiónem. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Sanctify, we beseech You, O Lord, the gifts offered, that by the intercession of blessed Louis Your confessor they may prepare for us a dwelling in the heavenly kingdom; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Concéde, quǽsumus omnípotens Deus: ut quos culpæ miséria fecit hic éxsules; beáti Ludovíci Regis et Confessóris tui intercéssio gloriósa, regni cæléstis fáciat esse coherédes: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that the glorious intercession of blessed Louis, Your king and confessor, may make co-heirs of the heavenly kingdom those whom the misery of sin has made exiles here; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Deus, qui nos hodiérna die Exaltatiónis sanctæ Crucis ánnua solemnitáte lætíficas: præsta quǽsumus, ut cujus mystérium in terra cognóvimus; ejus redemptiónis in cælo prǽmia consequámur: Per eúndem Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum Fílium tuum, qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

O God, who gladden us today by the yearly feast of the Exaltation of the holy Cross, grant, we beseech You, that we who have known its mystery on earth may obtain the rewards of its redemption in heaven; through the same Jesus Christ, Your Son, our Lord, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Hæc oblátio, quǽsumus Dómine, ab ómnibus nos purget offénsis: quæ in ara Crucis étiam totíus mundi tulit offénsam: Per eúndem Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum Fílium tuum, qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

May this offering, we beseech You, O Lord, cleanse us from all our sins, this offering which on the altar of the Cross took away the sin of the whole world; through the same Jesus Christ, Your Son, our Lord, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Refécti cibo, potúque cælésti, quǽsumus omnípotens Deus: ut ab hóstium deféndas formídine; quos pretióso Fílii tui Dómini nostri Jesu Christi Sánguine redemísti: Qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Refreshed with heavenly food and drink, we beseech You, almighty God, to defend from the fear of their enemies those whom You have redeemed by the precious Blood of Your Son our Lord Jesus Christ; who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Deus, qui Ecclésiam tuam beáti Patris nostri Francísci méritis, fetu novæ prolis amplíficas: tríbue nobis ex ejus imitatióne terréna despícere; et cæléstium donórum semper participatióne gaudére: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

O God, who by the merits of our blessed Father Francis enlarge Your Church with the increase of a new offspring, grant us by his example to despise earthly things and ever to rejoice in sharing heavenly gifts; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Múnera tibi Dómine dicáta sanctífica: et intercedénte beáto Patre nostro Francísco, ab omni nos culpárum labe purífica. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Sanctify, O Lord, the gifts dedicated to You, and by the intercession of our blessed Father Francis cleanse us from every stain of sin; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Ecclésiam tuam, quǽsumus Dómine, grátia cæléstis amplíficet; quam beáti Patris nostri Francísci Confessóris tui illumináre voluísti gloriósis méritis et exémplis: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

May heavenly grace, we beseech You, O Lord, increase Your Church, which You have willed to enlighten by the glorious merits and example of our blessed Father Francis, Your confessor; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Deus, qui beátum Raphaélem Archángelum Tobíæ fámulo tuo cómitem dedísti in via: concéde nobis fámulis tuis, ut ejúsdem semper protegámur custódia; et muniámur auxílio: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

O God, who gave blessed Raphael the Archangel to Your servant Tobias as a companion on his journey, grant to us Your servants that we may ever be protected by his care and defended by his help; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Hóstias tibi, Dómine, laudis offérimus, supplíciter deprecántes: ut eásdem, Angélico pro nobis interveniénte suffrágio, et placátus accípias, et ad salútem nostram proveníre concédas. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

We offer You, O Lord, sacrifices of praise, humbly entreating You that, the prayers of the Angels interceding for us, You may graciously accept them and grant that they may avail for our salvation; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Repléti, Dómine, benedictióne cælésti, supplíciter implorámus: ut quod frágili celebrámus offício; sanctórum Angelórum atque Archangelórum nobis prodésse sentiámus auxílio: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Filled, O Lord, with heavenly blessing, we humbly implore You that what we celebrate in our frail service we may feel to profit us by the help of the holy Angels and Archangels; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Deus, qui ad conteréndos Ecclésiæ tuæ hostes, et ad divínum cultum reparándum, beátum Pium Pontíficem máximum elígere dignátus es: fac nos ipsíus deféndi præsídiis, et ita tuis inhærére obséquiis; ut ómnium hóstium superátis insídiis, perpétua pace lætémur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

O God, who deigned to choose blessed Pius as supreme Pontiff to crush the enemies of Your Church and to restore divine worship, make us to be defended by his protection and so to cleave to Your service that, overcoming the snares of all our enemies, we may rejoice in everlasting peace; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Súscipe, quǽsumus Dómine, Ecclésiæ tuæ preces et oblatiónes: ut intercedénte beáto Pio Confessóre tuo atque Pontífice, in conspéctu tuo in odórem suavitátis ascéndant. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Receive, we beseech You, O Lord, the prayers and offerings of Your Church, that by the intercession of blessed Pius, Your confessor and bishop, they may rise in Your sight as an odor of sweetness; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Spíritum, Dómine Deus, justítiæ ac fortitúdinis benígnus infúnde fidélibus tuis; quos beáti Pii Confessóris tui atque Pontíficis zelo ac constántia, ab ómnium hóstium incursióne tuéri dignátus es: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Graciously pour out, O Lord God, the spirit of justice and fortitude on Your faithful, whom You have deigned to protect from the onslaught of all their enemies by the zeal and constancy of blessed Pius, Your confessor and bishop; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Deus, qui beátum Philíppum Confessórem tuum Sanctórum tuórum glória sublimásti: concéde propítius, ut cujus solemnitáte lætámur; ejus virtútum proficiámus exémplo: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

O God, who exalted blessed Philip, Your confessor, to the glory of Your Saints, mercifully grant that we who rejoice in his feast may profit by the example of his virtues; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Sacrifíciis præséntibus, quǽsumus Dómine, inténde placátus: et præsta, ut illo nos igne Spíritus Sanctus inflámmet, quo beáti Philíppi cor mirabíliter penetrávit. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte eiúsdem Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Look graciously, we beseech You, O Lord, upon this present sacrifice, and grant that the Holy Spirit may inflame us with that fire with which He wonderfully pierced the heart of blessed Philip; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the same Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Cæléstibus, Dómine, pasti delíciis: quǽsumus, ut beáti Philíppi Confessóris tui méritis et imitatióne; semper eádem, per quæ veráciter vívimus, appetámus: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Fed with heavenly delights, we beseech You, O Lord, that by the merits and example of blessed Philip, Your confessor, we may ever long for those things by which we truly live; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Dómine Jesu Christe, qui beátam Vírginem Iméldam igníto caritátis amóre sauciátam et immaculáta hóstia mirabíliter reféctam, in cælum suscepísti: fac nos ejus intercessióne, eódem caritátis fervóre ad Sacram Mensam accédere; ut appetámus dissólvi, et esse tecum mereámur: Qui vivis et regnas cum Deo Patre, in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

O Lord Jesus Christ, who took up into heaven the blessed virgin Imelda, wounded with the burning love of charity and wonderfully refreshed with the spotless Host, grant us by her intercession to approach the holy Table with the same fervor of charity, that we may long to be dissolved and deserve to be with You; who live and reign with God the Father, in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Súscipe, Dómine, múnera quæ tibi offérimus, et beátæ Iméldæ Vírginis intercedéntibus méritis, amóris tui nobis spíritum infúnde, ut terrénis affectiónibus despéctis, in te nostra fixa sint corda, ubi vera sunt gáudia. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Receive, O Lord, the gifts which we offer You, and, by the merits and intercession of blessed Imelda, virgin, pour into us the spirit of Your love, that, despising earthly affections, our hearts may be fixed on You, where true joys are; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Sit nobis, Dómine, ad thronum misericórdiæ tuæ pro nobis beáta Imélda virgo indefíciens exorátrix: ut sicut illa salutári hóstia percépta ad ætérnam glóriam evolávit; ita tanti participátio mystérii sit nobis ablútio scélerum in vita, et in morte via, qua ad vitam perveniámus ætérnam: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

May blessed Imelda, virgin, be for us, O Lord, an unfailing pleader before the throne of Your mercy, that, as she, having received the saving Host, flew to eternal glory, so the sharing of so great a mystery may be for us in life the cleansing of our sins, and in death the way by which we may come to life eternal; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

S0428.page: 420-421 (commemoration De S. Paulo a Cruce on 28 Apr.; printed without a conclusion, Qui vivis supplied)
or: Dómine Jesu Christe, qui ad mystérium crucis prædicándum, sanctum Paulum singulári caritáte donásti; et per eum novam in Ecclésia famíliam floréscere voluísti: ipsíus nobis intercessióne concéde; ut passiónem tuam júgiter recoléntes in terris, ejúsdem fructum cónsequi mereámur in cælis: Qui vivis et regnas cum Deo Patre, in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

O Lord Jesus Christ, who endowed saint Paul with singular charity to preach the mystery of the Cross, and willed that through him a new family should flourish in the Church, grant us by his intercession that, ever recalling Your passion on earth, we may deserve to obtain its fruit in heaven; who live and reign with God the Father, in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Cæléstem nobis, Dómine, prǽbeant mystéria hæc passiónis et mortis tuæ fervórem, quo sanctus Paulus, ea offeréndo, corpus suum hóstiam vivéntem, sanctam, tibíque placéntem exhíbuit: Qui vivis et regnas cum Deo Patre, in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

May these mysteries, O Lord, give us that fervor for Your passion and death with which saint Paul, in offering them, presented his body to You as a living sacrifice, holy and pleasing to You; who live and reign with God the Father, in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Súmpsimus, Dómine, divínum sacraméntum, imménsæ caritátis tuæ memoriále perpétuum: tríbue, quǽsumus, ut sancti Pauli méritis et imitatióne, aquam de fóntibus tuis hauriámus in vitam ætérnam saliéntem; et tuam sacratíssimam passiónem córdibus nostris impréssam, móribus et vita teneámus: Qui vivis et regnas cum Deo Patre, in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

We have received, O Lord, the divine sacrament, the everlasting memorial of Your boundless charity; grant, we beseech You, that by the merits and example of saint Paul we may draw from Your fountains water springing up into life eternal, and may hold fast in our conduct and life Your most sacred passion impressed upon our hearts; who live and reign with God the Father, in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Da, quǽsumus omnípotens Deus: ut qui beáti N. Mártyris tui atque Pontíficis solémnia cólimus; ejus apud te intercessiónibus adjuvémur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that we who keep the feast of blessed N., Your martyr and bishop, may be helped by his intercession with You; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Hæc hóstia, quǽsumus Dómine, emúndet nostra delícta: et ad sacrifícium celebrándum, subditórum tibi córpora mentésque sanctíficet. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

May this sacrifice, we beseech You, O Lord, cleanse us from our sins, and sanctify the bodies and minds of Your servants for the celebration of the sacrifice; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Refécti participatióne múneris sacri, quǽsumus Dómine Deus noster: ut cujus exséquimur cultum; intercedénte beáto N. Mártyre tuo atque Pontífice, sentiámus efféctum: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Refreshed by partaking of the sacred gift, we beseech You, O Lord our God, that, by the intercession of blessed N., Your martyr and bishop, we may feel the effect of the rite we perform; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Deus, qui nos concédis sanctórum Mártyrum tuórum N. et N. natalítia cólere; da nobis in ætérna beatitúdine de eórum societáte gaudére: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

O God, who grant us to keep the birthday of Your holy martyrs N. and N., grant us to rejoice in their company in everlasting bliss; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Múnera tibi, Dómine, nostræ devotiónis offérimus: quæ et pro tuórum tibi grata sint honóre Sanctórum, et nobis salutária, te miseránte, reddántur. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

We offer You, O Lord, the gifts of our devotion, that they may be pleasing to You for the honor of Your saints and, by Your mercy, become salutary to us; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Præsta nobis, quǽsumus Dómine, intercedéntibus sanctis Martýribus tuis N. et N.; ut quæ ore contígimus, pura mente capiámus: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Grant us, we beseech You, O Lord, by the intercession of Your holy martyrs N. and N., that what we have touched with our lips we may receive with a pure mind; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Deus, qui nos concédis sanctórum Mártyrum tuórum N. et N. natalítia cólere; da nobis in ætérna beatitúdine de eórum societáte gaudére: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

O God, who grant us to keep the birthday of Your holy martyrs N. and N., grant us to rejoice in their company in everlasting bliss; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Múnera tibi, Dómine, nostræ devotiónis offérimus: quæ et pro tuórum tibi grata sint honóre Sanctórum, et nobis salutária, te miseránte, reddántur. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

We offer You, O Lord, the gifts of our devotion, that they may be pleasing to You for the honor of Your saints and, by Your mercy, become salutary to us; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Præsta nobis, quǽsumus Dómine, intercedéntibus sanctis Martýribus tuis N. et N.; ut quæ ore contígimus, pura mente capiámus: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Grant us, we beseech You, O Lord, by the intercession of Your holy martyrs N. and N., that what we have touched with our lips we may receive with a pure mind; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Exáudi nos Deus salutáris noster: ut sicut de beátæ N. Vírginis tuæ festivitáte gaudémus; ita piæ devotiónis erudiámur afféctu: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Hear us, O God our Saviour, that as we rejoice in the feast of blessed N., Your virgin, so we may be taught the spirit of loving devotion; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Accépta tibi sit, Dómine, sacrátæ plebis oblátio pro tuórum honóre Sanctórum, quorum se méritis de tribulatióne percepísse cognóscit auxílium. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

May the offering of Your consecrated people be acceptable to You, O Lord, in honor of Your saints, through whose merits they acknowledge that they have received help in tribulation; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Satiásti Dómine famíliam tuam munéribus sacris: ejus, quǽsumus, semper interventióne nos réfove; cujus solémnia celebrámus: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

You have filled Your household, O Lord, with sacred gifts; ever refresh us, we beseech You, by the intercession of her whose feast we celebrate; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Intercéssio nos, quǽsumus Dómine, beáti Antónii Abbátis comméndet: ut quod nostris méritis non valémus; ejus patrocínio assequámur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

May the intercession of blessed Anthony the Abbot, we beseech You, O Lord, commend us to You, that what we cannot obtain by our own merits we may obtain by his patronage; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Sacris altáribus, Dómine, hóstias superpósitas sanctus Antónius Abbas, quǽsumus, in salútem nobis proveníre depóscat. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

May saint Anthony the Abbot, we beseech You, O Lord, ask that the sacrifices laid upon Your holy altars may avail for our salvation; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Prótegat nos, Dómine, cum tui perceptióne sacraménti, beátus Antónius Abbas, pro nobis intercedéndo: ut et conversatiónis ejus experiámur insígnia; et intercessiónis ipsíus percipiámus suffrágia: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

May blessed Anthony the Abbot, interceding for us, protect us, O Lord, together with the reception of Your sacrament, that we may both experience the excellence of his way of life and receive the help of his intercession; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Ecclésiam tuam, quǽsumus Dómine, grátia cæléstis amplíficet; quam beáti Joánnis Chrysóstomi Confessóris tui atque Pontíficis, illustráre voluísti gloriósis méritis et doctrínis: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

May heavenly grace, we beseech You, O Lord, increase Your Church, which You have willed to enlighten by the glorious merits and teaching of blessed John Chrysostom, Your confessor and bishop; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Passiónis Fílii tui, Dómine, memóriam recenséntes depóscimus: ut quod tibi in beáti Joánnis Chrysóstomi Pontíficis tui solemnitáte deférimus, sacrifícium sit accéptum. Per eúndem Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum Fílium tuum, qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Recalling the memory of the Passion of Your Son, O Lord, we ask that the sacrifice which we offer You on the feast of blessed John Chrysostom, Your bishop, may be acceptable; through the same Jesus Christ, Your Son, our Lord, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Hæc nos, quǽsumus Dómine, commúnio sancta lætíficet: qua beáti Joánnis Chrysóstomi Pontíficis tui suffrágiis, virtútes roboréntur intérius; et actus extérius piæ operatiónis excréscant: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

May this holy communion, we beseech You, O Lord, gladden us, that by the prayers of blessed John Chrysostom, Your bishop, our virtues may be strengthened within and the works of devout service may increase without; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Deus, qui in tuæ caritátis exémplum, ad fidélium redemptiónem sanctum Petrum Ecclésiam tuam nova prole fecundáre divínitus docuísti: ipsíus nobis intercessióne concéde, a peccáti servitúte solútis; in cælésti pátria perpétua libertáte gaudére: Qui vivis et regnas cum Deo Patre, in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

O God, You Who, as an example of Your love, divinely taught St. Peter to enrich Your Church with new offspring, a family of Religious devoted to the ransom of the faithful, grant by his intercession, that we may be released from the slavery of sin and rejoice in lasting freedom in heaven; who live and reign with God the Father, in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Præsta nobis, quǽsumus omnípotens Deus, ut nostræ humilitátis oblátio, et pro tuórum tibi grata sit honóre Sanctórum, et nos córpore páriter et mente puríficet. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Grant us, we beseech You, almighty God, that the offering of our lowliness may be pleasing to You in honor of Your saints, and may purify us alike in body and mind; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Quǽsumus omnípotens Deus: ut qui cæléstia aliménta percépimus; intercedénte beáto Petro Confessóre tuo, per hæc contra ómnia advérsa muniámur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

We beseech You, almighty God, that we who have received the food of heaven may, through the intercession of blessed Peter, Your confessor, be thereby defended against all adversity; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Deus, qui ad animárum salútem beátum Francíscum Confessórem tuum atque Pontíficem, ómnibus ómnia factum esse voluísti: concéde propítius, ut caritátis tuæ dulcédine perfúsi; ejus dirigéntibus mónitis, ac suffragántibus méritis, ætérna gáudia consequámur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

O God, Who for the salvation of souls willed that blessed Francis, Your Confessor and Bishop, should become all things to all men, mercifully grant that we, inspired by the sweetness of Your love, guided by his teachings, and aided by his merits, may attain the joys of everlasting life; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Omnípotens sempitérne Deus, múnera tuæ majestáti obláta, per intercessiónem beáti Francísci Pontíficis tui atque Doctóris, ad perpétuam nobis fac proveníre salútem. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Almighty and everlasting God, through the intercession of blessed Francis, Your bishop and doctor, make the gifts offered to Your majesty avail us unto everlasting salvation; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Sacraménta salútis nostræ suscipiéntes, concéde, quǽsumus omnípotens Deus: ut beáti Francísci Pontíficis tui atque Doctóris nos ubíque orátio ádjuvet; in cujus veneratióne hæc tuæ obtúlimus majestáti: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Receiving the sacraments of our salvation, grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that the prayer of blessed Francis, Your bishop and doctor, may help us everywhere, in whose veneration we have offered these gifts to Your majesty; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Deus, qui sanctum Joánnem Confessórem tuum adolescéntium patrem et magístrum excitásti; ac per eum, auxiliatríce Vírgine María, novas in Ecclésia tua famílias floréscere voluísti: concéde, quǽsumus, ut eódem caritátis igne succénsi; ánimas quǽrere, tibíque soli servíre valeámus: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

O God, Who in Your Confessor, blessed John, raised up a father and teacher of youth, and willed that through him, with the help of the Virgin Mary, new religious families should bloom in the Church, grant, we beseech You, that, inflamed by the same fire of love, we may seek to win souls and to serve You alone; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Súscipe, Dómine, oblatiónem mundam salutáris Hóstiæ et præsta, ut, te in ómnibus et super ómnia diligéntes, in glóriæ tuæ laudem vívere mereámur. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Accept, O Lord, this pure offering of the saving Host, and grant, that loving You in all and above all, we may be found worthy to live for the praise of Your glory; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Córporis et Sánguinis tui, Dómine, mystério satiátis, concéde, quǽsumus; ut, intercedénte sancto Joánne Confessóre, in gratiárum semper actióne maneámus: Qui vivis et regnas cum Deo Patre, in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Nourished with the mystery of Your Body and Blood, grant, we beseech You, O Lord, through the intercession of Saint John, Your Confessor, that we may continue to be thankful; who live and reign with God the Father, in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Omnípotens sempitérne Deus, majestátem tuam súpplices exorámus: ut sicut unigénitus Fílius tuus hodiérna die cum nostræ carnis substántia in templo est præsentátus; ita nos fácias purificátis tibi méntibus præsentári: Per eúndem Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum Fílium tuum, qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Almighty, eternal God, we humbly beseech Your majesty that, as Your only-begotten Son was this day presented in the temple in the nature of our flesh, so may You grant us to be presented to You with purified minds; through the same Jesus Christ, Your Son, our Lord, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Exáudi Dómine preces nostras: et ut digna sint múnera, quæ óculis tuæ majestátis offérimus, subsídium nobis, per intercessiónem beátæ Maríæ Vírginis, perpétuæ tuæ pietátis impénde. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

O Lord, heed our prayer, and give us the help of Your loving kindness so that the gifts we offer before the eyes of Your majesty may be worthy of You; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Quǽsumus Dómine Deus noster: ut sacrosáncta mystéria, quæ pro reparatiónis nostræ munímine contulísti; intercedénte beáta María semper Vírgine, et præsens nobis remédium esse fácias, et futúrum: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

We beseech You, O Lord our God, that the sacrament You have given as the bulwark of our atonement may be made a saving remedy for us in this life and in the life to come; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Deus, qui in Ecclésia tua nova semper instáuras exémpla virtútum: da pópulo tuo, beáti Andréæ Confessóris tui atque Pontíficis ita sequi vestígia; ut assequátur et prǽmia: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

O God, Who establish ever new examples of virtue in Your Church, grant that Your people may follow the footsteps of blessed Andrew, Your Confessor and Bishop, so that they may also obtain his reward; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Accépta sit in conspéctu tuo Dómine nostra devótio: ut ejus nobis fiat supplicatióne salutáris, pro cujus solemnitáte defértur. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

May our devotion be acceptable in Your sight, O Lord, and may it become saving for us through the supplication of him on whose feast it is offered; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Da, quǽsumus Dómine, fidélibus tuis, Sanctórum tuórum semper veneratióne lætári; et eórum perpétua supplicatióne muníri: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Grant, we beseech You, O Lord, to Your faithful ever to rejoice in the veneration of Your saints and to be defended by their unceasing intercession; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Deus, qui per sanctum Joánnem Ordinem sanctíssimæ Trinitátis, ad rediméndum de potestáte Saracenórum captívos, cǽlitus institúere dignátus es: præsta quǽsumus, ut ejus suffragántibus méritis; a captivitáte córporis et ánimæ, te adjuvánte, liberémur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

O God, Who graciously and by divine means founded through blessed John, the Order of the Most Holy Trinity to ransom captives from the hands of the Saracens, grant, we beseech You, that through Your help and the merits of his prayers we may be freed body and soul from captivity; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Præsta nobis, quǽsumus omnípotens Deus, ut nostræ humilitátis oblátio, et pro tuórum tibi grata sit honóre Sanctórum, et nos córpore páriter et mente puríficet. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Grant us, we beseech You, almighty God, that the offering of our lowliness may be pleasing to You in honor of Your saints, and may purify us alike in body and mind; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Quǽsumus omnípotens Deus: ut qui cæléstia aliménta percépimus; intercedénte beáto Joánne Confessóre tuo, per hæc contra ómnia advérsa muniámur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

We beseech You, almighty God, that we who have received the food of heaven may, through the intercession of blessed John, Your confessor, be thereby defended against all adversity; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Deus qui beátum Cyríllum Confessórem tuum atque Pontíficem divínæ maternitátis beatíssimæ Vírginis Maríæ assertórem invíctum effecísti: concéde, ipso intercedénte, ut qui vere eam Genitrícem Dei crédimus; matérna ejúsdem protectióne salvémur: Per eúndem Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum Fílium tuum, qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

O God, Who made Cyril, Your Confessor and Bishop, an unconquerable champion of the most Blessed Virgin Mary’s divine motherhood, grant that we who believe that she is truly the Mother of God may be saved by her motherly protection; through the same Jesus Christ, Your Son, our Lord, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Múnera nostra, omnípotens Deus, benígnus réspice: et intercedénte beáto Cyríllo præsta, ut Unigénitum tuum Jesum Christum Dóminum nostrum in tua tecum glória coætérnum, in córdibus nostris digne suscípere mereámur: Qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Look graciously, almighty God, upon our gifts and, through the intercession of blessed Cyril, grant that we may receive worthily into our hearts, Your only-begotten Son, Jesus Christ, our Lord, Who is with You co-eternal in Your glory; who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Divínis Dómine, refécti mystériis, Te súpplices deprecámur: ut exémplis et méritis beáti Cyrílli Pontíficis adjúti; sanctíssimæ Genitríci Unigéniti tui digne famulári valeámus: Qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Strengthened by the Blessed Sacrament, we humbly beseech You, O Lord, that, helped by the example and merits of the blessed Bishop Cyril, we may be worthy servants of the most holy Mother of Your only-begotten Son; who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Concéde nos, quǽsumus omnípotens Deus, beáti Petri Confessóris tui atque Pontíficis mónita et exémpla sectári; ut per terréstrium rerum contémptum, ætérna gáudia consequámur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Grant us, we beseech You, almighty God, to follow the counsel and examples of St. Peter, Your Confessor and Bishop, so that by setting earthly goods at naught we may attain everlasting happiness; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Omnípotens sempitérne Deus, múnera tuæ majestáti obláta, per intercessiónem beáti Petri Confessóris tui atque Doctóris, ad perpétuam nobis fac proveníre salútem. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Almighty and everlasting God, through the intercession of blessed Peter, Your confessor and doctor, make the gifts offered to Your majesty avail us unto everlasting salvation; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Sacraménta salútis nostræ suscipiéntes, concéde, quǽsumus omnípotens Deus: ut beáti Petri Confessóris tui atque Doctóris nos ubíque orátio ádjuvet; in cujus veneratióne hæc tuæ obtúlimus majestáti: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Receiving the sacraments of our salvation, grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that the prayer of blessed Peter, Your confessor and doctor, may help us everywhere, in whose veneration we have offered these gifts to Your majesty; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Deus, qui pópulo tuo ætérnæ salútis beátum Isidórum minístrum tribuísti: præsta quǽsumus, ut quem doctórem vitæ habúimus in terris; intercessórem habére mereámur in cælis: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

or: Sancti Antoníni, Dómine, Confessóris tui atque Pontíficis méritis adjuvémur: ut sicut te in illo mirábilem prædicámus; ita in nos misericórdem fuísse gloriémur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

May we be helped, O Lord, by the merits of saint Antoninus, Your confessor and bishop, that, as we proclaim You wonderful in him, so we may glory that You have been merciful to us; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Sacrifícium nostrum, Dómine, beátus Antonínus sacérdos majestátis tuæ óculis reddat accéptum: qui se tibi, dum vixit, sanctam et placéntem hóstiam immolávit. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

May blessed Antoninus the priest, O Lord, make our sacrifice acceptable in the eyes of Your majesty, he who while he lived offered himself to You as a holy and pleasing victim; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Vitáli cibo recreáti, grátias tibi Dómine ágimus: et rogámus, ut quod ad glóriam súmpsimus sancti tui Præsulis Antoníni; ejus précibus sit nobis contra hostíles ímpetus auxílium: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Refreshed with life-giving food, we give You thanks, O Lord, and ask that what we have received for the glory of Your holy bishop Antoninus may by his prayers be our help against the assaults of the enemy; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Deus, qui Ecclésiam tuam beáti Bedæ Confessóris tui atque Doctóris eruditióne claríficas: concéde propítius fámulis tuis; ejus semper illustrári sapiéntia et méritis adjuvári: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

O God, Who enlightened Your Church with the learning of blessed Bede, Your Confessor and Doctor, graciously grant that Your servants may ever be enlightened by his wisdom and helped by his merits; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Omnípotens sempitérne Deus, múnera tuæ majestáti obláta, per intercessiónem beáti Bedæ Confessóris tui atque Doctóris, ad perpétuam nobis fac proveníre salútem. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Almighty and everlasting God, through the intercession of blessed Bede, Your confessor and doctor, make the gifts offered to Your majesty avail us unto everlasting salvation; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Sacraménta salútis nostræ suscipiéntes, concéde, quǽsumus omnípotens Deus: ut beáti Bedæ Confessóris tui atque Doctóris nos ubíque orátio ádjuvet; in cujus veneratióne hæc tuæ obtúlimus majestáti: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
