or: Deus, qui beátum Norbértum Confessórem tuum atque Pontíficem, verbi tui præcónem exímium effecísti; et per eum Ecclésiam tuam nova prole fecundásti: præsta quǽsumus, ut ejúsdem suffragántibus méritis, quod ore simul et ópere dócuit; te adjuvánte exercére valeámus: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

O God, Who made blessed Norbert, Your Confessor and Bishop, a brilliant preacher of Your word, and through him enriched Your Church with a new religious family, grant, we beseech You, that by his prayerful intercession and Your help, we may be able to do what he has taught us by his words and deeds; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Sancti tui, quǽsumus Dómine, nos ubíque lætíficent: ut dum eórum mérita recólimus, patrocínia sentiámus. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

May Your saints, we beseech You, O Lord, everywhere gladden us, that while we recall their merits we may feel their protection; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Præsta, quǽsumus omnípotens Deus: ut de percéptis munéribus grátias exhibéntes; intercedénte beáto Norbérto Confessóre tuo atque Pontífice, benefícia potióra sumámus: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that, giving thanks for the gifts received, we may, by the intercession of blessed Norbert, Your confessor and bishop, receive still greater benefits; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Quǽsumus omnípotens Deus: ut beátus Bárnabas Apóstolus, tuum pro nobis implóret auxílium; ut a nostris reátibus absolúti, a cunctis étiam perículis eruámur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

We beseech You, almighty God, that blessed Barnabas the Apostle may implore Your help for us, that, being freed from our sins, we may also be delivered from all dangers; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Sacrándum tibi, Dómine, munus offérimus: quo beáti Bárnabæ Apóstoli tui solémnia recoléntes, purificatiónem quoque nostris méntibus implorámus. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

We offer You, O Lord, the gift to be consecrated, by which, keeping the feast of blessed Barnabas Your Apostle, we implore also the cleansing of our minds; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Percéptis Dómine sacraméntis, supplíciter exorámus: ut intercedénte beáto Bárnaba Apóstolo tuo, quæ pro illíus veneránda gérimus passióne; nobis profíciant ad medélam: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Having received the sacraments, O Lord, we humbly entreat You that, by the intercession of blessed Barnabas Your Apostle, what we do in veneration of his passion may avail for our healing; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Ecclésiam tuam, Deus, beáti Antónii Confessóris tui solémnitas votíva lætíficet: ut spirituálibus semper muniátur auxíliis; et gáudiis pérfrui mereátur ætérnis: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

May the devout feast of blessed Anthony, Your confessor, gladden Your Church, O God, that she may ever be defended by spiritual help and deserve to enjoy everlasting joys; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Præsens oblátio fiat, Dómine, pópulo tuo salutáris, pro quo dignátus es Patri tuo te vivéntem hóstiam immoláre: Qui cum eódem Deo Patre et Spíritu Sancto vivis et regnas Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

May this present offering, O Lord, be saving for Your people, for whom You deigned to offer Yourself to Your Father as a living victim; who with the same God the Father and the Holy Spirit live and reign, God, world without end.
pc: Divínis, Dómine, munéribus satiáti: quǽsumus, ut beáti Antónii Confessóris tui méritis gloriósis; salutáris víctimæ desiderátum sentiámus efféctum: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Filled with divine gifts, we beseech You, O Lord, that by the glorious merits of blessed Anthony, Your confessor, we may feel the longed-for effect of the saving Victim; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Deus, qui Ecclésiam tuam beáti Ephræm Confessóris tui et Doctóris mira eruditióne et præcláris vitæ méritis illustráre voluísti: te súpplices exorámus; ut, ipso intercedénte, eam advérsus erróris et pravitátis insídias perénni tua virtúte deféndas. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

O God, Who willed to enlighten Your Church by the wondrous learning and glorious merits of the life of blessed Ephrem, Your Confessor and Doctor, we humbly pray You, that, by his pleading, You will shield her with Your lasting power against the snares of error and evil; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Omnípotens sempitérne Deus, múnera tuæ majestáti obláta, per intercessiónem beáti Ephræm Confessóris tui atque Doctóris, ad perpétuam nobis fac proveníre salútem. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Almighty and everlasting God, through the intercession of blessed Ephrem, Your confessor and doctor, make the gifts offered to Your majesty avail us unto everlasting salvation; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Sacraménta salútis nostræ suscipiéntes, concéde, quǽsumus omnípotens Deus: ut beáti Ephræm Confessóris tui atque Doctóris nos ubíque orátio ádjuvet; in cujus veneratióne hæc tuæ obtúlimus majestáti: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Receiving the sacraments of our salvation, grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that the prayer of blessed Ephrem, Your confessor and doctor, may help us everywhere, in whose veneration we have offered these gifts to Your majesty; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Intercéssio nos, quǽsumus Dómine, beáti Joánnis Abbátis comméndet: ut quod nostris méritis non valémus; ejus patrocínio assequámur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

May the intercession of blessed John the Abbot, we beseech You, O Lord, commend us to You, that what we cannot obtain by our own merits we may obtain by his patronage; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Præsta nobis, quǽsumus omnípotens Deus, ut nostræ humilitátis oblátio, et pro tuórum tibi grata sit honóre Sanctórum, et nos córpore páriter et mente puríficet. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Grant us, we beseech You, almighty God, that the offering of our lowliness may be pleasing to You in honor of Your saints, and may purify us alike in body and mind; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Prótegat nos, Dómine, cum tui perceptióne sacraménti, beátus Joánnes Abbas, pro nobis intercedéndo: ut et conversatiónis ejus experiámur insígnia; et intercessiónis ipsíus percipiámus suffrágia: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

May blessed John the Abbot, interceding for us, protect us, O Lord, together with the reception of Your sacrament, that we may both experience the excellence of his way of life and receive the help of his intercession; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Deus, qui pópulo tuo ætérnæ salútis beátum Bonaventúram minístrum tribuísti: præsta quǽsumus, ut quem doctórem vitæ habúimus in terris; intercessórem habére mereámur in cælis: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

O God, who gave blessed Bonaventure to Your people as a minister of eternal salvation, grant, we beseech You, that we may deserve to have him as our intercessor in heaven whom we had as the teacher of life on earth; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Sancti Bonaventúræ Confessóris tui atque Pontíficis nobis, Dómine, pia non desit orátio: quæ et múnera nostra concíliet, et tuam nobis indulgéntiam semper obtíneat. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

May the loving prayer of saint Bonaventure, Your confessor and bishop, not fail us, O Lord, that it may make our gifts acceptable and ever obtain for us Your pardon; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Ut nobis, Dómine, tua sacrifícia dent salútem; beátus Bonaventúra Conféssor tuus et Póntifex, quǽsumus, precátor accédat. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

That Your sacrifices may give us salvation, O Lord, may blessed Bonaventure, Your confessor and bishop, we beseech You, come forward as our advocate; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Deus, qui hodiérna die beátum Henrícum Confessórem tuum e terréni cúlmine impérii ad regnum ætérnum transtulísti; te súpplices exorámus: ut sicut illum, grátiæ tuæ ubertáte prævéntum, illécebras sǽculi superáre fecísti; ita nos fácias, ejus imitatióne, mundi hujus blandiménta vitáre, et ad te puris méntibus perveníre: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

O God, Who on this day took St. Henry, Your Confessor, to the everlasting kingdom from the throne of an earthly empire; we humbly beseech You, that as You enabled him, protected by the abundance of Your grace, to overcome the temptations of the world, so grant that we, in emulation of him, may shun the allurements of this world and come to You with pure hearts; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Laudis tibi Dómine hóstias immolámus in tuórum commemoratióne Sanctórum: quibus nos et præséntibus éxui malis confídimus, et futúris: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

We offer You, O Lord, sacrifices of praise in commemoration of Your saints, through whom we trust to be delivered from evils both present and to come; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Refécti cibo potúque cælésti, Deus noster, te súpplices exorámus: ut in cujus hæc commemoratióne percépimus; ejus muniámur et précibus: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Refreshed with heavenly food and drink, O our God, we humbly entreat You that we may also be defended by the prayers of him in whose commemoration we have received these gifts; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Deus, qui præ ómnibus sanctis tuis beátum Jóachim Genitrícis Fílii tui patrem esse voluísti: concéde quǽsumus, ut cujus festa venerámur; ejus quoque perpétuo patrocínia sentiámus: Per eúndem Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum Fílium tuum, qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

O God, Who, in preference to Your other Saints, willed St. Joachim to be the father of Your Son’s Mother; grant, we beseech You, that we may ever enjoy the spiritual help of him whose feast we celebrate; through the same Jesus Christ, Your Son, our Lord, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Súscipe clementíssime Deus sacrifícium in honórem sancti Patriárchæ Jóachim, patris Maríæ Vírginis, majestáti tuæ oblátum: ut ipso cum cónjuge sua et beatíssima prole intercedénte, perféctam cónsequi mereámur remissiónem peccatórum, et glóriam sempitérnam. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Graciously accept, most merciful God, the sacrifice offered to Your majesty in honor of the holy Patriarch Joachim, father of the Virgin Mary, that by his intercession, together with that of his spouse and most blessed child, we may be found worthy to obtain full forgiveness of our sins and everlasting glory; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Quǽsumus omnípotens Deus, ut per hæc sacraménta, quæ súmpsimus: intercedéntibus méritis et précibus beáti Jóachim, patris Genitrícis dilécti Fílii tui Dómini nostri Jesu Christi; tuæ grátiæ in præsénti, et ætérnæ glóriæ in futúro partícipes esse mereámur: Per eúndem Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum Fílium tuum, qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

We beseech You, almighty God, that by this sacrament which we have received, and by the pleading merits of holy Joachim, father of the Mother of Your beloved Son, our Lord Jesus Christ, we may be found worthy to share Your grace in the life, and eternal glory in the life to come; through the same Jesus Christ, Your Son, our Lord, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Deus, qui pópulo tuo ætérnæ salútis beátum Bernárdum minístrum tribuísti: præsta quǽsumus, ut quem doctórem vitæ habúimus in terris; intercessórem habére mereámur in cælis: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

O God, who gave blessed Bernard to Your people as a minister of eternal salvation, grant, we beseech You, that we may deserve to have him as our intercessor in heaven whom we had as the teacher of life on earth; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Omnípotens sempitérne Deus, múnera tuæ majestáti obláta, per intercessiónem beáti Bernárdi Confessóris tui atque Doctóris, ad perpétuam nobis fac proveníre salútem. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Almighty and everlasting God, through the intercession of blessed Bernard, Your confessor and doctor, make the gifts offered to Your majesty avail us unto everlasting salvation; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Sacraménta salútis nostræ suscipiéntes, concéde, quǽsumus omnípotens Deus: ut beáti Bernárdi Confessóris tui atque Doctóris nos ubíque orátio ádjuvet; in cujus veneratióne hæc tuæ obtúlimus majestáti: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Receiving the sacraments of our salvation, grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that the prayer of blessed Bernard, Your confessor and doctor, may help us everywhere, in whose veneration we have offered these gifts to Your majesty; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Adésto supplicatiónibus nostris omnípotens Deus: et quibus fidúciam sperándæ pietátis indúlges; intercedénte beáto Augustíno Confessóre tuo atque Pontífice, consuétæ misericórdiæ tríbue benígnus efféctum: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Hearken to our supplications, almighty God, and, blessed Augustine, Your confessor and bishop, interceding, graciously grant the effect of Your wonted mercy to those to whom You give confidence to hope for Your loving-kindness; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Sancti Confessóris tui atque Pontíficis Augustíni nobis, Dómine, pia non desit orátio: quæ et múnera nostra concíliet, et tuam nobis indulgéntiam semper obtíneat. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

May the loving prayer of Your holy confessor and bishop Augustine not fail us, O Lord, that it may make our gifts acceptable and ever obtain for us Your pardon; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Ut nobis, Dómine, tua sacrifícia dent salútem; beátus Conféssor tuus Augustínus, et Póntifex, quǽsumus, precátor accédat: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

That Your sacrifices may give us salvation, O Lord, may blessed Augustine, Your confessor and bishop, we beseech You, come forward as our advocate; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Deus, qui miro órdine Angelórum ministéria hominúmque dispénsas; concéde propítius: ut a quibus tibi ministrántibus in cælo semper assístitur; ab his in terra vita nostra muniátur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

O God, Who assign according to a wondrous order the duties of Angels and men, mercifully grant that our life on earth be guarded by those who continually stand in Your presence and minister to You in heaven; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Hóstias tibi, Dómine, laudis offérimus, supplíciter deprecántes: ut eásdem, Angélico pro nobis interveniénte suffrágio, et placátus accípias, et ad salútem nostram proveníre concédas. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

We offer You sacrifices of praise, O Lord, humbly praying You to accept them graciously and to grant that they may be helpful for our salvation through the intercession of the Angels who intercede for us; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Beáti Archángeli tui Michaélis intercessióne suffúlti, súpplices te, Dómine, deprecámur: ut quod ore proséquimur; contingámus et mente: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Relying upon the intercession of blessed Michael, Your Archangel, O Lord, we humbly pray You, that what we have received by our mouth may give grace to our mind; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Omnípotens sempitérne Deus, qui in Corde beátæ Maríæ Vírginis dignum Spíritus Sancti habitáculum præparásti: concéde propítius, ut ejúsdem immaculáti Cordis festivitátem devóta mente recoléntes; secúndum cor tuum vívere valeámus: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte eiúsdem Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Almighty and everlasting God, who in the Heart of the blessed Virgin Mary prepared a dwelling worthy of the Holy Spirit, mercifully grant that, keeping with devout minds the feast of her Immaculate Heart, we may be able to live according to Your heart; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the same Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Majestáti tuæ, Dómine, Agnum immaculátum offeréntes, quǽsumus, ut corda nostra ignis ille divínus accéndat, qui Cor beátæ Maríæ Vírginis ineffabíliter inflammávit: Per eúndem Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum Fílium tuum, qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Offering to Your majesty, O Lord, the spotless Lamb, we beseech You that our hearts may be kindled by that divine fire which ineffably inflamed the Heart of the blessed Virgin Mary; through the same Jesus Christ, Your Son, our Lord, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Divínis refécti munéribus te, Dómine, supplíciter exorámus: ut beátæ Maríæ Vírginis intercessióne, cujus immaculáti Cordis solémnia venerándo égimus; a præséntibus perículis liberáti, ætérnæ vitæ gáudia consequámur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Refreshed with divine gifts, we humbly entreat You, O Lord, that by the intercession of the blessed Virgin Mary, whose Immaculate Heart we have venerated in this feast, we may be freed from present dangers and attain the joys of eternal life; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Intervéniat pro nobis, quǽsumus Dómine Jesu Christe, nunc et in hora mortis nostræ apud tuam cleméntiam beáta Virgo María Mater tua: cujus sacratíssimam ánimam in hora benedíctæ passiónis tuæ dolóris gládius pertransívit; et in gloriósa resurrectióne tua ingens gáudium lætificávit: Qui vivis et regnas cum Deo Patre, in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

May the blessed Virgin Mary, Your Mother, intercede for us with Your mercy, we beseech You, O Lord Jesus Christ, now and at the hour of our death, she whose most holy soul was pierced by the sword of sorrow in the hour of Your blessed passion, and gladdened with great joy in Your glorious resurrection; who live and reign with God the Father, in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Offérimus tibi preces et hóstias, Dómine Jesu Christe, humíliter supplicántes: ut qui transfixiónem dulcíssimi spíritus beátæ Maríæ Matris tuæ précibus recensémus; suo suorúmque sub cruce Sanctórum consórtium multiplicáto piíssimo intervéntu, méritis mortis tuæ, méritum cum Beátis habeámus: Qui vivis et regnas cum Deo Patre, in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

We offer You prayers and sacrifices, O Lord Jesus Christ, humbly beseeching You that we who by our prayers recall the piercing of the most sweet spirit of blessed Mary Your Mother may, by the manifold and most loving intercession of her and of the Saints with her beneath the Cross, have through the merits of Your death a share with the Blessed; who live and reign with God the Father, in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Sacrifícia, quæ súmpsimus, Dómine Jesu Christe, transfixiónem Matris tuæ et Vírginis devóte celebrántes; nobis ímpetrent apud cleméntiam tuam omnis boni salutáris efféctum: Qui vivis et regnas cum Deo Patre, in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

May the sacrifices which we have received, O Lord Jesus Christ, as we devoutly celebrate the piercing of Your Mother and Virgin, obtain for us from Your mercy the effect of every saving good; who live and reign with God the Father, in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Intervéniat pro nobis, quǽsumus Dómine Jesu Christe, nunc et in hora mortis nostræ apud tuam cleméntiam beáta Virgo María Mater tua: cujus sacratíssimam ánimam in hora benedíctæ passiónis tuæ dolóris gládius pertransívit; et in gloriósa resurrectióne tua ingens gáudium lætificávit: Qui vivis et regnas cum Deo Patre, in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

se: Offérimus tibi preces et hóstias, Dómine Jesu Christe, humíliter supplicántes: ut qui transfixiónem dulcíssimi spíritus beátæ Maríæ Matris tuæ précibus recensémus; suo suorúmque sub cruce Sanctórum consórtium multiplicáto piíssimo intervéntu, méritis mortis tuæ, méritum cum Beátis habeámus: Qui vivis et regnas cum Deo Patre, in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

We offer You prayers and sacrifices, O Lord Jesus Christ, humbly beseeching You that we who by our prayers recall the piercing of the most sweet spirit of blessed Mary Your Mother may, by the manifold and most loving intercession of her and of the Saints with her beneath the Cross, have through the merits of Your death a share with the Blessed; who live and reign with God the Father, in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Sacrifícia, quæ súmpsimus, Dómine Jesu Christe, transfixiónem Matris tuæ et Vírginis devóte celebrántes; nobis ímpetrent apud cleméntiam tuam omnis boni salutáris efféctum: Qui vivis et regnas cum Deo Patre, in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

May the sacrifices which we have received, O Lord Jesus Christ, as we devoutly celebrate the piercing of Your Mother and Virgin, obtain for us from Your mercy the effect of every saving good; who live and reign with God the Father, in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Sancti Brunónis Confessóris tui, quǽsumus Dómine, intercessiónibus adjuvémur: ut qui majestátem tuam gráviter delinquéndo offéndimus; ejus méritis et précibus, nostrórum delictórum véniam consequámur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

May we be aided by the intercession of St. Bruno, Your Confessor, we beseech You, O Lord; that we, who have grievously offended Your Majesty by sin, may, by his merits and prayers, obtain forgiveness for our offenses; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Laudis tibi Dómine hóstias immolámus in tuórum commemoratióne Sanctórum: quibus nos et præséntibus éxui malis confídimus, et futúris. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

We offer You, O Lord, sacrifices of praise in commemoration of Your saints, through whom we trust to be delivered from evils both present and to come; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Quǽsumus omnípotens Deus: ut qui cæléstia aliménta percépimus; intercedénte beáto Brunóne Confessóre tuo, per hæc contra ómnia advérsa muniámur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

We beseech You, almighty God, that we who have received the food of heaven may, through the intercession of blessed Bruno, Your confessor, be thereby defended against all adversity; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Deus, qui beátum Petrum Confessórem tuum admirábilis pœniténtiæ, et altíssimæ contemplatiónis múnere illustráre dignátus es: da nobis, quǽsumus; ut ejus suffragántibus méritis, carne mortificáti facílius cæléstia capiámus: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

O God, Who graciously made blessed Peter, Your Confessor, glorious by the gift of remarkable penance and sublime contemplation, grant, we beseech You, that, by the merit of his prayers, we may the more easily understand the things of heaven by curbing our passions; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Præsta nobis, quǽsumus omnípotens Deus, ut nostræ humilitátis oblátio, et pro tuórum tibi grata sit honóre Sanctórum, et nos córpore páriter et mente puríficet. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Grant us, we beseech You, almighty God, that the offering of our lowliness may be pleasing to You in honor of Your saints, and may purify us alike in body and mind; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Quǽsumus omnípotens Deus: ut qui cæléstia aliménta percépimus; intercedénte beáto Petro Confessóre tuo, per hæc contra ómnia advérsa muniámur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

We beseech You, almighty God, that we who have received the food of heaven may, through the intercession of blessed Peter, Your confessor, be thereby defended against all adversity; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Fidélium, Deus, ómnium cónditor et redémptor: animábus famulórum, famularúmque tuárum remissiónem cunctórum tríbue peccatórum; ut indulgéntiam, quam semper optavérunt, piis supplicatiónibus consequántur: Qui vivis et regnas cum Deo Patre, in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

O God, the creator and redeemer of all the faithful, grant to the souls of Your servants and handmaids the remission of all their sins, that by loving prayers they may obtain the pardon they have always desired; who live and reign with God the Father, in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Hóstias, quǽsumus, Dómine, quas tibi pro animábus famulórum, famularúmque tuárum offérimus, propitiátus inténde; ut quibus fídei christiánæ méritum contulísti, dones et prǽmium. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Look graciously, we beseech You, O Lord, on the sacrifices which we offer You for the souls of Your servants and handmaids, that to those on whom You bestowed the merit of Christian faith You may give also its reward; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Animábus, quǽsumus, Dómine, famulórum famularúmque tuárum, orátio profíciat supplicántium: ut eas et a peccátis ómnibus éxuas; et tuæ redemptiónis fácias esse partícipes: Qui vivis et regnas cum Deo Patre, in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

May the prayer of Your suppliants, we beseech You, O Lord, profit the souls of Your servants and handmaids, that You may free them from all their sins and make them partakers of Your redemption; who live and reign with God the Father, in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Deus, indulgentiárum Dómine; da animábus famulórum famularúmque tuárum, refrigérii sedem, quiétis beatitúdinem, et lúminis claritátem: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

O God, the Lord of mercies, grant to the souls of Your servants and handmaids a place of refreshment, the happiness of rest and the brightness of light; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Propitiáre, Dómine, supplicatiónibus nostris, pro animábus famulórum famularúmque tuárum, pro quibus tibi offérimus sacrifícium laudis; ut eas Sanctórum tuórum consórtio sociáre dignéris. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Be appeased, O Lord, by our supplications for the souls of Your servants and handmaids, for whom we offer You the sacrifice of praise, that You may deign to join them to the fellowship of Your Saints; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Præsta, quǽsumus, Dómine, ut ánimæ famulórum famularúmque tuárum, his purgátæ sacrifíciis; indulgéntiam páriter, et réquiem cápiant sempitérnam: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Grant, we beseech You, O Lord, that the souls of Your servants and handmaids, being cleansed by this sacrifice, may obtain both pardon and everlasting rest; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Deus, véniæ largítor, et humánæ salútis auctor, quǽsumus cleméntiam tuam: ut ánimas famulórum famularúmque tuárum, quæ ex hoc sǽculo transiérunt; beáta María semper Vírgine intercedénte cum ómnibus Sanctis tuis, ad perpétuæ beatitúdinis consórtium perveníre concédas: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

O God, the giver of pardon and author of man's salvation, we beseech Your mercy that, blessed Mary ever Virgin interceding with all Your Saints, You would grant the souls of Your servants and handmaids who have passed out of this world to come to the fellowship of everlasting bliss; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Deus, cujus misericórdiæ non est númerus, súscipe propítius preces humilitátis nostræ: et animábus ómnium fidélium defunctórum, quibus tui nóminis dedísti confessiónem, per hæc sacraménta salútis nostræ, cunctórum remissiónem tríbue peccatórum. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

O God, whose mercy is without measure, mercifully receive the prayers of our lowliness, and through these sacraments of our salvation grant the remission of all sins to the souls of all the faithful departed, to whom You gave the confession of Your name; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Præsta, quǽsumus, omnípotens et miséricors Deus: ut ánimæ famulórum famularúmque tuárum, pro quibus hoc sacrifícium laudis tuæ obtúlimus majestáti; per hujus virtútem sacraménti, a peccátis ómnibus expiátæ, lucis perpétuæ, te miseránte, recípiant beatitúdinem: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Grant, we beseech You, almighty and merciful God, that the souls of Your servants and handmaids, for whom we have offered this sacrifice of praise to Your majesty, may by the power of this sacrament be cleansed from all their sins and, by Your mercy, receive the happiness of everlasting light; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Ecclésiam tuam, Dómine, sancti Cároli Confessóris tui atque Pontíficis contínua protectióne custódi: ut sicut illum pastorális sollicitúdo gloriósum effécit; ita nos ejus intercéssio in tuo semper fáciat amóre fervéntes: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Guard Your Church, O Lord, by the continual protection of saint Charles, Your confessor and bishop, that, as his pastoral care made him glorious, so his intercession may make us ever fervent in Your love; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Da miséricors Deus, ut hæc salutáris oblátio, intercedénte beáto Cárolo Confessóre tuo atque Pontífice, et a própriis nos reátibus indesinénter expédiat, et ab ómnibus tueátur advérsis. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Grant, O merciful God, that this saving offering, by the intercession of blessed Charles, Your confessor and bishop, may ever free us from our own sins and defend us against all adversities; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Præsta, quǽsumus Dómine Deus noster: ut quorum festivitáte votíva sunt sacraménta; eórum intercessióne salutária nobis reddántur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Grant, we beseech You, O Lord our God, that the sacraments which are offered on the feast of Your saints may by their intercession become saving for us; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Deus, qui cónspicis quia ex nulla nostra virtúte subsístimus; concéde propítius, ut intercessióne beáti Martíni Confessóris tui atque Pontíficis, contra ómnia advérsa muniámur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

O God, who see that we do not stand by any strength of our own, mercifully grant that by the intercession of blessed Martin, Your confessor and bishop, we may be defended against all adversities; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Da miséricors Deus, ut hæc salutáris oblátio, et a própriis nos reátibus indesinénter expédiat, et ab ómnibus tueátur advérsis. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Grant, O merciful God, that this saving offering may ever free us from our own sins and defend us against all adversities; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Præsta, quǽsumus Dómine Deus noster: ut quorum festivitáte votíva sunt sacraménta; eórum intercessióne salutária nobis reddántur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Grant, we beseech You, O Lord our God, that the sacraments which are offered on the feast of Your saints may by their intercession become saving for us; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Da, quǽsumus omnípotens Deus: ut beáti Gregórii Confessóris tui atque Pontíficis veneránda solémnitas; et devotiónem nobis áugeat, et salútem: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that the venerable feast of blessed Gregory, Your confessor and bishop, may increase in us both devotion and salvation; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Sancti tui, quǽsumus Dómine, nos ubíque lætíficent: ut dum eórum mérita recólimus, patrocínia sentiámus. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

May Your saints, we beseech You, O Lord, everywhere gladden us, that while we recall their merits we may feel their protection; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Præsta, quǽsumus omnípotens Deus: ut de percéptis munéribus grátias exhibéntes; intercedénte beáto Gregório Confessóre tuo atque Pontífice, benefícia potióra sumámus: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that, giving thanks for the gifts received, we may, by the intercession of blessed Gregory, Your confessor and bishop, receive still greater benefits; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Deus, qui beátum Felícem Confessórem tuum ex erémo ad munus rediméndi captívos cǽlitus vocáre dignátus es: præsta quǽsumus, ut per grátiam tuam ex peccatórum nostrórum captivitáte, ejus intercessióne, liberáti; ad cæléstem pátriam perducámur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

O God, Who by heavenly inspiration graciously called forth blessed Felix, Your Confessor, from the desert to the work of ransoming captives; grant, we beseech You, that by his intercession, and liberated by Your grace from the captivity of our sins, we may be led into our heavenly fatherland; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Laudis tibi Dómine hóstias immolámus in tuórum commemoratióne Sanctórum: quibus nos et præséntibus éxui malis confídimus, et futúris. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

We offer You, O Lord, sacrifices of praise in commemoration of Your saints, through whom we trust to be delivered from evils both present and to come; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Refécti cibo potúque cælésti, Deus noster, te súpplices exorámus: ut in cujus hæc commemoratióne percépimus; ejus muniámur et précibus: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Refreshed with heavenly food and drink, O our God, we humbly entreat You that we may also be defended by the prayers of him in whose commemoration we have received these gifts; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Deus, qui sanctum Joánnem Confessórem tuum atque Doctórem perféctæ sui abnegatiónis, et crucis amatórem exímium effecísti: concéde, ut ejus imitatióni júgiter inhæréntes; glóriam assequámur ætérnam: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

O God, who made saint John, Your confessor and doctor, an outstanding lover of perfect self-denial and of the Cross, grant that, ever cleaving to his example, we may attain everlasting glory; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Omnípotens sempitérne Deus, múnera tuæ majestáti obláta, per intercessiónem beáti Joánnis Confessóris tui atque Doctóris, ad perpétuam nobis fac proveníre salútem. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Almighty and everlasting God, through the intercession of blessed John, Your confessor and doctor, make the gifts offered to Your majesty avail us unto everlasting salvation; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Sacraménta salútis nostræ suscipiéntes, concéde, quǽsumus omnípotens Deus: ut beáti Joánnis Confessóris tui atque Doctóris nos ubíque orátio ádjuvet; in cujus veneratióne hæc tuæ obtúlimus majestáti: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Receiving the sacraments of our salvation, grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that the prayer of blessed John, Your confessor and doctor, may help us everywhere, in whose veneration we have offered these gifts to Your majesty; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Deus, qui dedísti legem Móysi in summitáte montis Sínai, et in eódem loco per sanctos Angelos tuos corpus beátæ Catharínæ Vírginis et Mártyris tuæ mirabíliter collocásti: præsta quǽsumus, ut ejus méritis et intercessióne; ad montem, qui Christus est, perveníre valeámus: Qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

O God, who gave the law to Moses on the summit of Mount Sinai, and in that same place wonderfully laid the body of blessed Catherine, Your virgin and martyr, by Your holy Angels, grant, we beseech You, that by her merits and intercession we may be able to come to the mountain which is Christ; who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Hóstia, quǽsumus Dómine, quam tibi sanctæ Catharínæ Vírginis et Mártyris tuæ natalítia recenséntes offérimus, et víncula nostræ pravitátis absólvat, et tuæ nobis misericórdiæ dona concíliet. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

May the sacrifice, O Lord, which we offer You keeping the birthday of saint Catherine, Your virgin and martyr, both loose the bonds of our wickedness and win for us the gifts of Your mercy; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Quǽsumus Dómine salutáribus repléti mystériis: ut cujus solémnia celebrámus; ejus oratiónibus adjuvémur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Filled with saving mysteries, we beseech You, O Lord, that we may be helped by the prayers of her whose feast we celebrate; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Deus, qui beátum Petrum Chrysólogum Doctórem egrégium divínitus præmonstrátum, ad regéndam et instruéndam Ecclésiam tuam éligi voluísti: præsta quǽsumus, ut quem Doctórem vitæ habúimus in terris; intercessórem habére mereámur in cælis: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

O God, who willed that blessed Peter Chrysologus, the excellent Doctor divinely foreshown, should be chosen to rule and instruct Your Church, grant, we beseech You, that we may deserve to have him as our intercessor in heaven whom we had as the teacher of life on earth; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Sancti Petri Chrysólogi Pontíficis tui atque Doctóris nobis, Dómine, pia non desit orátio: quæ et múnera nostra concíliet, et tuam nobis indulgéntiam semper obtíneat. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

May the loving prayer of saint Peter Chrysologus, Your bishop and doctor, not fail us, O Lord, that it may make our gifts acceptable and ever obtain for us Your pardon; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Ut nobis, Dómine, tua sacrifícia dent salútem; beátus Petrus Chrysólogus Póntifex tuus et Doctor egrégius, quǽsumus, precátor accédat: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

That Your sacrifices may give us salvation, O Lord, may blessed Peter Chrysologus, Your bishop and excellent doctor, we beseech You, come forward as our advocate; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Exáudi nos Deus salutáris noster: ut sicut de beátæ Lúciæ Vírginis et Mártyris tuæ festivitáte gaudémus; ita piæ devotiónis erudiámur afféctu: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Hear us, O God our Saviour, that as we rejoice in the feast of blessed Lucy, Your virgin and martyr, so we may be taught the spirit of loving devotion; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Accépta tibi sit, Dómine, sacrátæ plebis oblátio pro tuórum honóre Sanctórum, quorum se méritis de tribulatióne percepísse cognóscit auxílium. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

May the offering of Your consecrated people be acceptable to You, O Lord, in honor of Your saints, through whose merits they acknowledge that they have received help in tribulation; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Satiásti Dómine famíliam tuam munéribus sacris: ejus, quǽsumus, semper interventióne nos réfove; cujus solémnia celebrámus: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

You have filled Your household, O Lord, with sacred gifts; ever refresh us, we beseech You, by the intercession of her whose feast we celebrate; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Da nobis, quǽsumus Dómine, imitári quod cólimus, ut discámus et inimícos dilígere: quia ejus natalítia celebrámus; qui novit étiam pro persecutóribus exoráre Dóminum nostrum Jesum Christum Fílium tuum: Qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Grant us, we beseech You, O Lord, to imitate what we venerate, that we may learn to love even our enemies, since we keep the birthday of him who knew how to pray even for his persecutors to our Lord Jesus Christ Your Son; who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Súscipe Dómine múnera pro tuórum commemoratióne Sanctórum: ut sicut illos pássio gloriósos effécit, ita nos devótio reddat innócuos. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Receive, O Lord, these gifts in commemoration of Your saints, that, as their passion made them glorious, so our devotion may make us blameless; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Auxiliéntur nobis, Dómine, sumpta mystéria; et intercedénte beáto Stéphano Mártyre tuo, sempitérna protectióne confírment: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

May the mysteries we have received help us, O Lord, and, by the intercession of blessed Stephen Your martyr, strengthen us with everlasting protection; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Excita Dómine corda nostra ad præparándas Unigéniti tui vias; ut per ejus advéntum, purificátis tibi méntibus servíre mereámur: Qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Stir up our hearts, O Lord, to prepare the ways of Your only-begotten Son, so that through His coming we may be able to serve You with purified minds; who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Placáre, quǽsumus Dómine, humilitátis nostræ précibus, et hóstiis: et ubi nulla súppetunt suffrágia meritórum, tuis nobis succúrre præsídiis. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Be appeased, we beseech You, O Lord, by the prayers and offerings of our human frailty, and where the support of our own merits is lacking, come to our assistance with Your protection; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Repléti cibo spiritális alimóniæ, súpplices te Dómine deprecámur: ut hujus participatióne mystérii dóceas nos terréna despícere; et amáre cæléstia: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

We who have been refreshed by the food of spiritual nourishment, humbly beseech You, O Lord, that through partaking of this sacrament You will teach us to disdain the things of earth and love those of heaven; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Dómine Jesu Christe, qui Maríæ et Joseph súbditus, domésticam vitam ineffabílibus virtútibus consecrásti: fac nos, utriúsque auxílio, Famíliæ sanctæ tuæ exémplis ínstrui; et consórtium cónsequi sempitérnum: Qui vivis et regnas cum Deo Patre, in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

O Lord Jesus Christ, You Who while subject to Mary and Joseph, hallowed family life with virtues beyond description, grant us by their combined intercession, that, having been taught by the example of the Holy Family, we may attain unto their everlasting companionship; who live and reign with God the Father, in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Placatiónis hóstiam offérimus tibi, Dómine, supplíciter deprecántes: ut, per intercessiónem Deíparæ Vírginis cum beáto Joseph, famílias nostras in pace et grátia tua fírmiter constítuas. Per eúndem Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum Fílium tuum, qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

In appeasement, O Lord, we offer You this sacrifice, humbly praying that through the intercession of the Virgin Mother of God, and that of St. Joseph, You will establish our households in Your peace and grace; through the same Jesus Christ, Your Son, our Lord, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Quos cæléstibus réficis sacraméntis, fac, Dómine Jesu, sanctæ Famíliæ tuæ exémpla júgiter imitári; ut, in hora mortis nostræ, occurrénte gloriósa Vírgine Matre tua cum beáto Joseph, per te in ætérna tabernácula récipi mereámur: Qui vivis et regnas cum Deo Patre, in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Grant, Lord Jesus, that those whom You refresh with the heavenly sacrament may ever imitate the example of Your Holy Family, so that at the hour of our death, with the glorious Virgin Mary and St. Joseph welcoming us, we may be found worthy to be received into Your everlasting home; who live and reign with God the Father, in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Deus, qui nobis nati Salvatóris diem celebráre concédis octávum: fac nos, quǽsumus, ejus perpétua Divinitáte muníri; cujus sumus carnáli commércio reparáti: Qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

O God, who grant us to keep the eighth day from the birth of our Saviour, make us, we beseech You, to be defended by His everlasting Godhead, by whose fellowship in our flesh we have been restored; who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Præsta, quǽsumus Dómine, ut per hæc múnera, quæ Dómini nostri Jesu Christi arcánæ Nativitátis mystério gérimus, purificátæ mentis intelligéntiam consequámur. Per eúndem Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum Fílium tuum, qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Grant, we beseech You, O Lord, that through these gifts which we offer in the mystery of the hidden Nativity of our Lord Jesus Christ, we may obtain the understanding of a purified mind; through the same Jesus Christ, Your Son, our Lord, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Præsta, quǽsumus Dómine: ut quod Salvatóris nostri iteráta festivitáte percépimus; perpétuæ nobis redemptiónis cónferat medicínam: Per eúndem Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum Fílium tuum, qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Grant, we beseech You, O Lord, that what we have received in the renewed feast of our Saviour may bring us the healing of everlasting redemption; through the same Jesus Christ, Your Son, our Lord, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Absólve, quǽsumus Dómine, tuórum delícta populórum: ut a peccatórum nostrórum néxibus, quæ pro nostra fragilitáte contráximus; tua benignitáte liberémur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Forgive, we beseech You, O Lord, the sins of Your faithful people, so that by Your goodness we may be released from the net of sin in which we have been caught by our weakness; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Pro nostræ servitútis augménto, sacrifícium tibi, Dómine, laudis offérimus: ut quod imméritis contulísti, propítius exsequáris. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

We offer You O Lord, the sacrifice of praise that we may serve You even better, so that You may graciously complete what You have given us, Your undeserving servants; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Quǽsumus omnípotens Deus: ut quos divína tríbuis participatióne gaudére; humánis non sinas subjacére perículis: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

We beseech You, almighty God, let not human dangers overcome us to whom You grant joyful participation in things divine; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

G502_3.page: 478-479 (In Vigilia SS. Petri et Pauli, 28 Jun.)
or: Præsta, quǽsumus omnípotens Deus: ut nullis nos permíttas perturbatiónibus cóncuti; quos in Apostólicæ confessiónis petra solidásti: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that You suffer not to be shaken by any disturbances us whom You have set firm on the rock of the Apostolic confession; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Munus pópuli tui, quǽsumus Dómine, Apostólica intercessióne sanctífica, nosque a peccatórum nostrórum máculis emúnda. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Sanctify, we beseech You, O Lord, the gift of Your people by the intercession of the Apostles, and cleanse us from the stains of our sins; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Quos cælésti, Dómine, aliménto satiásti; Apostólicis intercessiónibus ab omni adversitáte custódi: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Guard from all adversity, by the intercession of the Apostles, O Lord, those whom You have filled with heavenly food; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Omnípotens sempitérne Deus, qui in dilécto Fílio tuo, universórum Rege, ómnia instauráre voluísti: concéde propítius ut cunctæ famíliæ Géntium, peccáti vúlnere disgregátæ; ejus suavíssimo subdántur império: Qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Almighty and eternal God, Who willed to restore all things in Your beloved Son, the King of the Universe, graciously grant that the peoples of the earth torn asunder by the wound of sin, may submit to His most gentle rule; who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Hóstiam tibi, Dómine, humánæ reconciliatiónis offérimus: præsta, quǽsumus; ut Quem sacrifíciis præséntibus immolámus, Ipse cunctis Géntibus unitátis et pacis dona concédat, Jesus Christus Fílius tuus Dóminus noster: Qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

O Lord, we offer You this sacrificial Victim of mankind's reconciliation with You; grant, we beseech You, that our Lord Jesus Christ, your Son, Whom we offer in this sacrifice, may bestow upon all peoples the gifts of unity and peace; who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Immortalitátis alimóniam consecúti, quǽsumus, Dómine: ut, qui sub Christi Regis vexíllis militáre gloriámur, cum Ipso, in cælésti sede, júgiter regnáre possímus: Qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

We have received the food of eternal life, and we beseech You, O Lord, that we who are proud to serve under the flag of Christ the King may forever reign with Him in the Kingdom of heaven; who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Deus, qui nos ánnua sanctórum Mártyrum tuórum Gervásii et Protásii solemnitáte lætíficas: concéde propítius, ut quorum gaudémus méritis; accendámur exémplis: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

O God, who gladden us by the yearly feast of Your holy martyrs Gervase and Protase, mercifully grant that we may be kindled by the example of those in whose merits we rejoice; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Múnera tibi, Dómine, dicáta sanctífica: et intercedéntibus sanctis Martýribus tuis Gervásio et Protásio, per éadem nos placátus inténde. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Sanctify, O Lord, the gifts dedicated to You, and, Your holy martyrs Gervase and Protase interceding, look graciously upon us through them; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Salutáris tui, Dómine, múnere satiáti, súpplices exorámus: ut cujus lætámur gustu; intercedéntibus sanctis Martýribus tuis Gervásio et Protásio, renovémur efféctu: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Filled with the gift of Your salvation, we humbly pray You, O Lord, that, Your holy martyrs Gervase and Protase interceding, we may be renewed by the effect of that which we rejoice to taste; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Adésto Dómine supplicatiónibus nostris: ut qui ex iniquitáte nostra reos nos esse cognóscimus; beáti N. Mártyris tui intercessióne liberémur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Hearken, O Lord, to our supplications, that we who know ourselves to be guilty by our iniquity may be delivered by the intercession of blessed N., Your martyr; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Munéribus nostris, quǽsumus Dómine, precibúsque suscéptis: intercedénte beáto N. Mártyre tuo, et cæléstibus nos munda mystériis, et cleménter exáudi. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Having received our gifts and prayers, we beseech You, O Lord, that by the intercession of blessed N., Your martyr, You would both cleanse us by heavenly mysteries and mercifully hear us; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Quǽsumus omnípotens Deus: ut qui cæléstia aliménta percépimus; intercedénte beáto N. Mártyre tuo, per hæc contra ómnia advérsa muniámur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

We beseech You, almighty God, that we who have received heavenly food may, by the intercession of blessed N., Your martyr, be thereby defended against all adversity; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Da, quǽsumus omnípotens Deus: ut qui beáti N. Mártyris tui atque Pontíficis solémnia cólimus; ejus apud te intercessiónibus adjuvémur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that we who keep the feast of blessed N., Your martyr and bishop, may be helped by his intercession with You; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Hæc hóstia, quǽsumus Dómine, emúndet nostra delícta: et ad sacrifícium celebrándum, subditórum tibi córpora mentésque sanctíficet. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

May this sacrifice, we beseech You, O Lord, cleanse us from our sins, and sanctify the bodies and minds of Your servants for the celebration of the sacrifice; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Refécti participatióne múneris sacri, quǽsumus Dómine Deus noster: ut cujus exséquimur cultum; intercedénte beáto N. Mártyre tuo atque Pontífice, sentiámus efféctum: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Refreshed by partaking of the sacred gift, we beseech You, O Lord our God, that, by the intercession of blessed N., Your martyr and bishop, we may feel the effect of the rite we perform; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Præsta, quǽsumus omnípotens Deus: ut qui beáti N. Mártyris tui natalítia cólimus; a cunctis malis imminéntibus ejus intercessióne liberémur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that we who keep the birthday of blessed N., Your martyr, may by his intercession be delivered from all threatening evils; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Hóstias tibi, Dómine, beáti N. Mártyris tui dicátas méritis, benígnus assúme: et ad perpétuum nobis tríbue proveníre subsídium. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Graciously accept, O Lord, the sacrifices dedicated to You by the merits of blessed N., Your martyr, and grant that they may avail us for everlasting help; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Sumptis, Dómine, sacraméntis: quǽsumus, ut intercedénte beáto N. Mártyre tuo; supplicatiónes nostras placátus inténdas: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Having received the sacraments, O Lord, we beseech You that, by the intercession of blessed N., Your martyr, You may graciously hearken to our supplications; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Præsta, quǽsumus omnípotens Deus: ut qui gloriósos Mártyres fortes in sua confessióne cognóvimus; pios apud te in nostra intercessióne sentiámus: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that we who have known the glorious martyrs to be steadfast in their confession may feel them to be loving intercessors for us with You; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Benedíctio tua Dómine larga descéndat: quæ et múnera nostra, deprecántibus sanctis Martýribus tuis, tibi reddat accépta, et nobis sacraméntum redemptiónis effíciat. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

May Your blessing, O Lord, come down abundantly, that, Your holy martyrs pleading, it may make our gifts acceptable to You and make for us the sacrament of redemption; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Cæléstibus refécti sacraméntis et gáudiis, súpplices te Dómine deprecámur: ut quorum gloriámur triúmphis; protegámur auxíliis: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Refreshed with heavenly sacraments and joys, we humbly pray You, O Lord, that we may be protected by the help of those in whose triumphs we glory; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Da, quǽsumus omnípotens Deus: ut beáti N. Confessóris tui atque Pontíficis veneránda solémnitas; et devotiónem nobis áugeat, et salútem: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that the venerable feast of blessed N., Your confessor and bishop, may increase in us both devotion and salvation; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Sancti tui, quǽsumus Dómine, nos ubíque lætíficent: ut dum eórum mérita recólimus, patrocínia sentiámus. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

May Your saints, we beseech You, O Lord, everywhere gladden us, that while we recall their merits we may feel their protection; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Præsta, quǽsumus omnípotens Deus: ut de percéptis munéribus grátias exhibéntes; intercedénte beáto N. Confessóre tuo atque Pontífice, benefícia potióra sumámus: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that, giving thanks for the gifts received, we may, by the intercession of blessed N., Your confessor and bishop, receive still greater benefits; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Exáudi, quǽsumus Dómine, preces nostras, quas in beáti N. Confessóris tui atque Pontíficis solemnitáte deférimus: ut qui tibi digne méruit famulári; ejus intercedéntibus méritis, ab ómnibus nos absólvas peccátis: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Hear, we beseech You, O Lord, the prayers which we offer on the feast of blessed N., Your confessor and bishop, that by the merits and intercession of him who was found worthy to serve You, You may absolve us from all our sins; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Accépta sit in conspéctu tuo Dómine nostra devótio: ut ejus nobis fiat supplicatióne salutáris, pro cujus solemnitáte defértur. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

May our devotion be acceptable in Your sight, O Lord, and may it become saving for us through the supplication of him on whose feast it is offered; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Da, quǽsumus Dómine, fidélibus tuis, Sanctórum tuórum semper veneratióne lætári; et eórum perpétua supplicatióne muníri: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Grant, we beseech You, O Lord, to Your faithful ever to rejoice in the veneration of Your saints and to be defended by their unceasing intercession; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Deus, qui pópulo tuo ætérnæ salútis beátum N. minístrum tribuísti: præsta quǽsumus, ut quem doctórem vitæ habúimus in terris; intercessórem habére mereámur in cælis: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

O God, who gave blessed N. to Your people as a minister of eternal salvation, grant, we beseech You, that we may deserve to have him as our intercessor in heaven whom we had as the teacher of life on earth; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Omnípotens sempitérne Deus, múnera tuæ majestáti obláta, per intercessiónem beáti N. Confessóris tui atque Doctóris, ad perpétuam nobis fac proveníre salútem. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Almighty and everlasting God, through the intercession of blessed N., Your confessor and doctor, make the gifts offered to Your majesty avail us unto everlasting salvation; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Sacraménta salútis nostræ suscipiéntes, concéde, quǽsumus omnípotens Deus: ut beáti N. Confessóris tui atque Doctóris nos ubíque orátio ádjuvet; in cujus veneratióne hæc tuæ obtúlimus majestáti: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Receiving the sacraments of our salvation, grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that the prayer of blessed N., Your confessor and doctor, may help us everywhere, in whose veneration we have offered these gifts to Your majesty; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Adésto Dómine supplicatiónibus nostris, quas in beáti N. Confessóris tui solemnitáte deférimus: ut qui nostræ justítiæ fidúciam non habémus; ejus, qui tibi plácuit, précibus adjuvémur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Hearken, O Lord, to the prayers which we offer on the feast of blessed N., Your confessor, that we who have no confidence in our own righteousness may be helped by the prayers of him who pleased You; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Præsta nobis, quǽsumus omnípotens Deus, ut nostræ humilitátis oblátio, et pro tuórum tibi grata sit honóre Sanctórum, et nos córpore páriter et mente puríficet. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Grant us, we beseech You, almighty God, that the offering of our lowliness may be pleasing to You in honor of Your saints, and may purify us alike in body and mind; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Quǽsumus omnípotens Deus: ut qui cæléstia aliménta percépimus; intercedénte beáto N. Confessóre tuo, per hæc contra ómnia advérsa muniámur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
