We beseech You, almighty God, that we who have received the food of heaven may, through the intercession of blessed N., Your confessor, be thereby defended against all adversity; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Indulgéntiam nobis, quǽsumus Dómine, beáta N. Virgo et Martyr implóret: quæ tibi grata semper éxstitit; et mérito castitátis, et tuæ professióne virtútis: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

May blessed N., virgin and martyr, we beseech You, O Lord, implore pardon for us, she who was ever pleasing to You both by the merit of her chastity and by the confession of Your power; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Súscipe Dómine múnera, quæ in beátæ N. Vírginis et Mártyris tuæ solemnitáte deférimus: cujus nos confídimus patrocínio liberári. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Receive, O Lord, the gifts we bring on the feast of blessed N., Your virgin and martyr, by whose patronage we trust to be delivered; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Auxiliéntur nobis, Dómine, sumpta mystéria; et intercedénte beáta N. Vírgine et Mártyre tua, sempitérna protectióne confírment: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

May the mysteries we have received help us, O Lord, and, through the intercession of blessed N., Your virgin and martyr, strengthen us with everlasting protection; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Omnípotens sempitérne Deus, qui infírma mundi éligis, ut fórtia quæque confúndas: concéde propítius, ut qui beátæ N. Vírginis et Mártyris tuæ solémnia cólimus; ejus apud te patrocínia sentiámus: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Almighty and everlasting God, who choose the weak things of the world to confound the strong, mercifully grant that we who keep the feast of blessed N., Your virgin and martyr, may feel the help of her patronage with You; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Hóstias, Dómine, quas tibi offérimus, propítius súscipe: et intercedénte beáta N. Vírgine et Mártyre tua, víncula peccatórum nostrórum absólve. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Mercifully receive, O Lord, the sacrifices which we offer You, and, by the intercession of blessed N., Your virgin and martyr, loose the bonds of our sins; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Refécti cibo, potúque cælésti, Deus noster, te súpplices exorámus: ut in cujus hæc commemoratióne percépimus; ejus muniámur et précibus: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Refreshed with heavenly food and drink, O our God, we humbly entreat You that we may also be defended by the prayers of her in whose commemoration we have received these gifts; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Tuórum corda fidélium Deus miserátor illústra: et beátæ N. précibus gloriósis, fac nos próspera mundi despícere; et cælésti semper consolatióne gaudére: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

O merciful God, enlighten the hearts of Your faithful, and by the glorious prayers of blessed N. make us despise the prosperity of the world and ever rejoice in heavenly consolation; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Múnera, Dómine, nostræ devotiónis offérimus: ut tibi grata, et nobis salutária, beátæ N. pia supplicatióne reddántur. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

We offer You, O Lord, the gifts of our devotion, that they may become pleasing to You and salutary to us through the devout supplication of blessed N; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Quǽsumus omnípotens Deus: ut quos salutáribus dignátus es erudíre mystériis; beátæ N. intercessióne gloriósa, cæléstibus refícias aliméntis: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

We beseech You, almighty God, that those whom You have deigned to instruct by the saving mysteries You may refresh with heavenly food through the glorious intercession of blessed N; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Deus, qui Ecclésiam tuam beáti Thomæ Confessóris tui atque Doctóris mira eruditióne claríficas, et sancta operatióne fecúndas: da nobis, quǽsumus, et quæ dócuit, intelléctu conspícere; et quæ egit, imitatióne complére: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

O God, who enlighten Your Church by the wonderful learning of blessed Thomas, Your confessor and doctor, and make her fruitful by his holy works, grant us, we beseech You, both to understand what he taught and to fulfil by imitation what he did; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Passiónis Fílii tui, Dómine, memóriam recenséntes depóscimus, ut quod tibi in beáti Thomæ Confessóris tui atque Doctóris solemnitáte deférimus, sacrifícium sit accéptum. Per eúndem Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum Fílium tuum, qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Recalling the memory of the Passion of Your Son, O Lord, we ask that the sacrifice which we offer You on the feast of blessed Thomas, Your confessor and doctor, may be acceptable; through the same Jesus Christ, Your Son, our Lord, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Hæc nos, quǽsumus Dómine, commúnio sancta lætíficet: qua beáti Thomæ Confessóris tui atque Doctóris suffrágiis, virtútes roboréntur intérius; et actus extérius piæ operatiónis excréscant. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

May this holy communion, we beseech You, O Lord, gladden us, that by the prayers of blessed Thomas, Your confessor and doctor, our virtues may be strengthened within and the works of devout service may increase without; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Deus qui beátæ Zedíslavæ concédere dignátus es, ut te júgiter erécta mente contemplarétur, únaque próximo sollícite prospíceret: ea intercedénte, fac nos diligénti stúdio cæléstibus insístere; et caritátem piis opéribus exercére: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

O God, who were pleased to grant to blessed Zedislava that she should ever contemplate You with uplifted mind and at the same time care diligently for her neighbor; at her intercession make us apply ourselves with earnest zeal to heavenly things, and exercise charity in works of piety; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Oblátum tibi Dómine sacrifícium, intercedénte beáta Zedíslava, vivíficet nos semper et múniat. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

May the sacrifice offered to You, O Lord, through the prayer of blessed Zedislava, ever quicken and defend us; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Hæc nos, quǽsumus Dómine, commúnio sancta lætíficet: qua beátæ Zedíslavæ suffrágiis virtútes roboréntur in córdibus; et actus sanctæ operatiónis excréscant: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

May this holy communion give us joy, we beseech You, O Lord; whereby through the prayers of blessed Zedislava virtues may be strengthened in our hearts, and our deeds of holiness may increase; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Omnípotens sempitérne Deus, qui beátum Confessórem tuum Regináldum singulári sanctíssimæ Genitrícis tuæ protectióne donásti: illíus nobis méritis et précibus concéde; ut ejúsdem gloriósæ semper Vírginis Maríæ perpétuo muniámur auxílio: Qui vivis et regnas cum Deo Patre, in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Almighty, everlasting God, who endowed blessed Reginald, Your confessor, with the singular protection of Your most holy Mother; grant us by his merits and prayers, that we may be ever defended by the help of the same glorious ever-Virgin Mary; who live and reign with God the Father, in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Adésto supplicatiónibus nostris miséricors Deus: ut hæc oblátio salutáris in honórem beáti Confessóris tui Regináldi exhíbita, ad úberem grátiam tuam nobis impetrándam, in odórem suavitátis ascéndat. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Be near to our prayers, O God of mercy, that this life-giving offering, made in honor of Your blessed confessor Reginald, may rise as an odor of sweetness to win for us Your plenteous grace; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Ineffabílibus refécti sacraméntis, quǽsumus clementíssime Jesu, intercedénte beáto Regináldo Confessóre tuo, ab omni nos ánimæ et córporis infirmitáte custódi: ut divíni óperis fructum propénsius exsequéntes; in ætérnam íngredi réquiem festinémus: Qui vivis et regnas cum Deo Patre, in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Refreshed by these ineffable sacraments, we beseech You, most merciful Jesus, at the intercession of blessed Reginald, Your confessor, keep us from every infirmity of soul and body; that, pursuing more readily the fruit of this divine work, we may hasten to enter into eternal rest; who live and reign with God the Father, in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Deus, qui beátam Villánam fámulam tuam a mundi illécebris revocátam, per omnes pœniténtiæ et humilitátis sémitas transíre fecísti: illíus intercessióne concéde; ut reátus nostri conféssio indulgéntiam tuam váleat inveníre: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

O God, who called back blessed Villana, Your handmaid, from the allurements of the world, and made her pass along all the paths of penance and humility; grant by her intercession that the confession of our guilt may find Your pardon; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Beátæ Villánæ memóriam recoléntes, acceptábile fiat sacrifícium, quod tibi offérimus Dómine Deus, ut delictórum nostrórum véniam percípere mereámur. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

While we call to mind the memory of blessed Villana, may this sacrifice which we offer to You, O Lord our God, be acceptable; that we may deserve to obtain the pardon of our transgressions; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Cæléstibus refécti delíciis, quǽsumus omnípotens Deus: ut intercedénte beáta Villána, a peccatórum néxibus solúti, et grátiæ tuæ ubertáte repléti; tibi semper adhæreámus: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Refreshed by these heavenly delights, we pray You, almighty God, that through the intercession of blessed Villana we, being loosed from the bonds of sin and filled with the fullness of Your grace, may cleave forever to You; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Deus, qui inter regáles delícias, et mundi illécebras sanctum Casimírum virtúte constántiæ roborásti: quǽsumus, ut ejus intercessióne fidéles tui terréna despíciant; et ad cæléstia semper aspírent: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

O God, who by the virtue of steadfastness strengthened Saint Casimir amidst royal delights and worldly allurements; grant, we beseech You, that by his intercession Your faithful may scorn the things of earth and ever aspire to the things of heaven; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Laudis tibi Dómine hóstias immolámus in tuórum commemoratióne Sanctórum: quibus nos et præséntibus éxui malis confídimus, et futúris. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

We offer You, O Lord, victims of praise in memory of Your saints; and trust thereby to be freed from all ills both present and to come; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Refécti cibo potúque cælésti, Deus noster, te súpplices exorámus: ut in cujus hæc commemoratióne percépimus; ejus muniámur et précibus: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Refreshed with this heavenly food and drink, O our God, we humbly pray that we may be helped by the prayers of him in whose memory we have received it; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Deus, qui ad prædicándam géntibus glóriam tuam, beátum Patrícium Confessórem atque Pontíficem míttere dignátus es: ejus méritis et intercessióne concéde; ut quæ nobis agénda prǽcipis, te miseránte adimplére possímus: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

O God, who were pleased to send forth blessed Patrick, confessor and bishop, to preach Your glory among the Gentiles; grant, through his merits and intercession, that what You command us to do, we may by Your mercy be able to accomplish; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Sancti tui, quǽsumus Dómine, nos ubíque lætíficent: ut dum eórum mérita recólimus, patrocínia sentiámus. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Let Your saints, O Lord, everywhere make us glad; that while we remember their merits we may experience their help; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Præsta, quǽsumus omnípotens Deus: ut de percéptis munéribus grátias exhibéntes; intercedénte beáto Patrício Confessóre tuo atque Pontífice, benefícia potióra sumámus: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that giving thanks for the gifts received, we may, through the intercession of blessed Patrick, Your confessor and bishop, obtain still greater benefits; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Ecclésiam tuam, Deus, beáti Ambrósii Confessóris tui solémnitas votíva lætíficet: ut spirituálibus semper muniátur auxíliis; et gáudiis pérfrui mereátur ætérnis: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

May the hallowed feast of blessed Ambrose, Your confessor, gladden Your Church, O God; that she may be ever defended by spiritual help, and made worthy to enjoy everlasting joys; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Præsens oblátio fiat, Dómine, pópulo tuo salutáris, pro quo dignátus es Patri tuo te vivéntem hóstiam immoláre: Qui cum eódem Deo Patre et Spíritu Sancto vivis et regnas Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

May the present offering become life-giving to Your people, O Lord, for whom You were pleased to offer Yourself to Your Father as a living victim: who with the same God the Father and the Holy Spirit live and reign God, world without end.
pc: Divínis, Dómine, munéribus satiáti; quǽsumus, ut beáti Ambrósii Confessóris tui méritis gloriósis, salutáris víctimæ desiderátum sentiámus efféctum: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Filled with Your divine gifts, O Lord, we pray that through the glorious merits of blessed Ambrose, Your confessor, we may feel the desired effect of the saving victim; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Deus largítor caritátis: qui beátum Joánnem Confessórem atque Pontíficem in conservánda Ecclésiæ unitáte, instaurandáque regulári disciplína virtúte roborásti; per ipsíus intercessiónem tríbue nobis idípsum sentíre et fácere in Christo Jesu Dómino nostro: Qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

O God, the giver of charity, who strengthened blessed John, Your confessor and bishop, with power to preserve the unity of the Church and to restore regular discipline; grant us by his intercession to be of one mind and to act as one in Christ Jesus our Lord; who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Per ipsam immaculátam hóstiam, quam tibi Dómine offérimus, concéde, ut intercedénte beáto Joánne Confessóre tuo atque Pontífice, fidem et pacem servémus júgiter in Christo Jesu Dómino nostro: Qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Through this unblemished victim which we offer You, O Lord, grant at the prayer of blessed John, Your confessor and bishop, that we may ever preserve faith and peace in Christ Jesus our Lord; who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Largíre benígnus in nobis, Dómine: ut hujus sacrifícii partícipes effécti; per mérita beáti Joánnis Confessóris atque Pontíficis, omnis boni grátiam in præsénti, et ætérnæ retributiónis prǽmium tríbuas in futúro: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Be bountiful towards us, O Lord, that we who have been made partakers of this sacrifice may, through the merits of blessed John, Your confessor and bishop, receive from You the grace of every good thing in this present life and the reward of eternal recompense in the life to come; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Deus, qui beátum Innocéntium Confessórem atque Pontíficem, sciéntiæ ac prudéntiæ donis decorátum, pacis et unitátis conciliatórem effecísti: ejus intercessióne nobis concéde cæléstia sápere; et ómnia bona concórdi stúdio sectári: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

O God, who adorned blessed Innocent, Your confessor and bishop, with the gifts of knowledge and prudence, and made him a maker of peace and unity; grant us by his intercession to relish the things of heaven, and to pursue all good things with one mind; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Præsénti oblatióne, Dómine, atque beáti Innocéntii Pontíficis et Confessóris intercessióne propitiátus, fidélibus tuis pacis et unitátis dona largíre: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Appeased by this present offering, O Lord, and by the prayers of blessed Innocent, bishop and confessor, bestow on Your faithful the gifts of peace and unity; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Hujus, Dómine, Sacraménti percéptio, beáto Innocéntio Pontífice et Confessóre intercedénte, quǽsumus; ut salútem et pacem in nobis operétur ætérnam: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

We beseech You, O Lord, by the intercession of blessed Innocent, bishop and confessor, that the receiving of this sacrament may work in us eternal health and peace; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Deus, qui beátum Leónem Pontíficem, Sanctórum tuórum méritis coæquásti: concéde propítius, ut qui commemoratiónis ejus festa percólimus; vitæ quoque imitémur exémpla: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

O God, who made blessed Leo, the pontiff, equal in merit to Your saints; grant in Your mercy that we who keep the feast of his commemoration may also follow the example of his life; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Annue nobis, quǽsumus Dómine, ut intercessióne beáti Leónis hæc nobis prosit oblátio, quam immolándo totíus mundi tribuísti relaxári delícta. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Grant us, we pray You, O Lord, that through the intercession of blessed Leo this offering may profit us, by whose immolation You have granted the sins of the whole world to be loosed; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Deus, qui ánimæ fámuli tui Leónis ætérnæ beatitúdinis prǽmia contulísti: concéde propítius, ut qui peccatórum nostrórum póndere prémimur; ejus apud te précibus sublevémur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

O God, who bestowed on the soul of Your servant Leo the rewards of eternal blessedness; mercifully grant that we who are weighed down by the burden of our sins may be raised up by his prayers before You; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Deus, qui beátum Benedíctum Pontíficem tuum benedictiónis tuæ grátia sublevásti ad cælum: pópulum tuum, quǽsumus, nova benedictióne grátiæ tuæ sanctífica; et a cunctis malis imminéntibus, ejus méritis et précibus, tua nos virtúte defénde: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

O God, who by the grace of Your blessing raised up blessed Benedict, Your pontiff, to heaven; sanctify Your people, we beseech You, with a new blessing of Your grace, and by his merits and prayers defend us by Your power from all evils that threaten; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Accépta sit in conspéctu tuo Dómine nostra devótio: ut ejus nobis fiat supplicatióne salutáris, pro cujus solemnitáte defértur. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

May our devotion be acceptable in Your sight, O Lord, that it may profit us for salvation through the pleading of him on whose feast it is offered; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Da, quǽsumus Dómine, fidélibus tuis, Sanctórum tuórum semper veneratióne lætári; et eórum perpétua supplicatióne muníri: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Grant to Your faithful, we beseech You, O Lord, ever to rejoice in the veneration of Your saints, and to be fortified by their unceasing prayer; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Deus, qui beátum Jacóbum Confessórem atque Pontíficem, exímium veritátis præcónem, et pacis conciliatórem effecísti: ejus nobis intercessióne concéde, ut pacem et veritátem diligámus; et ad te, in quo pax summa est, et pura véritas, perveniámus: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

O God, who made blessed James, Your confessor and bishop, an outstanding herald of the truth and a maker of peace; grant us by his intercession to love peace and truth, and to come to You, in whom is perfect peace and pure truth; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Accépta sit in conspéctu tuo Dómine nostra devótio: ut ejus nobis fiat supplicatióne salutáris, pro cujus solemnitáte defértur. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

May our devotion be acceptable in Your sight, O Lord, that it may profit us for salvation through the pleading of him on whose feast it is offered; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Da, quǽsumus Dómine, fidélibus tuis, Sanctórum tuórum semper veneratióne lætári; et eórum perpétua supplicatióne muníri: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Grant to Your faithful, we beseech You, O Lord, ever to rejoice in the veneration of Your saints, and to be fortified by their unceasing prayer; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Deus, qui beátum Cesláum, virgíneo morum candóre prǽditum, et salútis animárum zelo succénsum, in divérsis natiónum pópulis óperum sanctitáte, et fídei propagatióne mirábilem effecísti: præsta quǽsumus, ut ejus intercessióne simus semper in fide stábiles; et ad te, qui solus es ætérnæ salútis auctor et largítor, misericórdiæ tuæ múnere perveníre valeámus: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

O God, who made blessed Ceslaus, endowed with virginal purity of life and on fire with zeal for the salvation of souls, wonderful among the peoples of many nations by the holiness of his works and the spreading of the faith; grant, we beseech You, that by his intercession we may ever be steadfast in the faith, and by the gift of Your mercy may come to You, who alone are the author and giver of eternal salvation; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Præsta nobis, quǽsumus omnípotens Deus, ut nostræ humilitátis oblátio, et pro tuórum tibi grata sit honóre Sanctórum, et nos córpore páriter et mente puríficet. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Grant us, we beseech You, almighty God, that the offering of our lowliness may be pleasing to You for the honor of Your saints, and may cleanse us in body and mind alike; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Quǽsumus omnípotens Deus: ut qui cæléstia aliménta percépimus; intercedénte beáto Cesláo Confessóre tuo, per hæc contra ómnia advérsa muniámur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

We beseech You, almighty God, that we who have received this heavenly food may, through the intercession of blessed Ceslaus, Your confessor, be defended by it against all adversity; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Deus, qui beátum Mannem Confessórem tuum, dispositióne mirábili in viam perfectiónis traduxísti: eádem misericórdiæ grátia dírige actus nostros; ut possímus quǽrere quod jubes, et ássequi quod promíttis: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

O God, who by a wonderful disposition led blessed Mannes, Your confessor, into the way of perfection; by the same grace of Your mercy direct our actions, that we may seek what You command and attain what You promise; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Deus, qui per beátum Mannem immaculátam hóstiam benígne suscípere dignátus es: per mérita ejúsdem hæc, quam tibi hódie offérimus, sit nobis propitiatória ad salútem. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

O God, who were graciously pleased to receive the spotless victim through blessed Mannes; through his merits may this victim which we offer You today avail us for salvation; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Deus, qui beátum Mannem cumuláta glória coronásti: per hujus suscépti sacrifícii virtútem tríbue nobis ita pie vívere in terris; ut cum eo coronári mereámur in cælis: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

O God, who crowned blessed Mannes with abundant glory; by the power of this sacrifice which we have received, grant us so to live devoutly on earth that we may deserve to be crowned with him in heaven; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Deus, qui beátæ Joánnæ fámulæ tuæ grátiam supérnæ vocatiónis fílii sui Domínici mirabíliter ostendísti: quǽsumus, ut ipsam, præmonstratúmque fílium imitántes; pio utriúsque intervéntu ætérna prǽmia consequámur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

O God, who wonderfully showed to blessed Joan, Your handmaid, the grace of the heavenly calling of her son Dominic; grant, we beseech You, that imitating her and the son foreshown to her, we may by the loving intercession of both attain eternal rewards; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Deus, in cujus conspéctu hæc, quam offérimus, hóstia placábilis semper appáret: largíre, ut per beátæ Joánnæ méritum, filiíque Domínici, propitiatória sit nobis ad salútem. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

O God, in whose sight this victim which we offer is ever pleasing; grant that through the merit of blessed Joan and of her son Dominic it may avail us for salvation; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Cælésti pasti dulcédine, ineffábilem tuam Deus exorámus cleméntiam; ut hæc hóstia, intercedéntibus méritis beátæ Joánnæ, ac sancti fílii sui Domínici, sit nobis ablútio scélerum, grátiæ participátio, ac prǽmii ætérni consecútio: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Fed with heavenly sweetness, we implore Your ineffable mercy, O God, that by the merits and intercession of blessed Joan and of her holy son Dominic, this victim may be for us the cleansing of our sins, a share in grace, and the attainment of the eternal reward; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Deus, qui sancto Patriárchæ Domínico beátum Bertrándum Confessórem tuum, sócium et imitatórem exímium adjunxísti: ejus nobis pio intervéntu concéde, ita ejúsdem sequi vestígia; ut assequámur et prǽmia: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

O God, who joined to the holy patriarch Dominic blessed Bertrand, Your confessor, as his companion and outstanding imitator; grant us by his loving intercession so to follow in his footsteps that we may also attain his rewards; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Sacrifícium nostrum, quǽsumus Dómine, beáti Bertrándi Confessóris tui intercéssio sancta comméndet: ut quam ipse in eo offeréndo noxárum véniam pro peccatóribus júgiter implorábat, facílius nos ejus méritis a tua misericórdia impetrémus. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

May the holy intercession of blessed Bertrand, Your confessor, commend our sacrifice to You, we beseech You, O Lord; that the pardon of offenses which he unceasingly implored for sinners in offering it, we may the more readily obtain from Your mercy by his merits; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Quos cælésti récreas alimónia, clementíssime Deus, beáti Bertrándi Confessóris tui extólle præsídio: ut inter ómnia adversántis mundi perícula, et devóti tibi permáneant; et secúri consístant: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Those whom You refresh with heavenly food, most merciful God, raise up by the protection of blessed Bertrand, Your confessor; that amid all the dangers of a hostile world they may remain devoted to You and stand secure; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Deus, qui nos beáti Geórgii Mártyris tui méritis et intercessióne lætíficas: concéde propítius, ut qui tua per eum benefícia póscimus; dono tuæ grátiæ consequámur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

O God, who gladden us by the merits and intercession of blessed George, Your martyr; mercifully grant that we who through him ask Your benefits may obtain them by the gift of Your grace; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Múnera Dómine obláta sanctífica: et intercedénte beáto Geórgio Mártyre tuo, nos per hæc a peccatórum nostrórum máculis emúnda. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Sanctify, O Lord, the gifts offered to You, and at the intercession of blessed George, Your martyr, cleanse us by them from the stains of our sins; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Súpplices te rogámus, omnípotens Deus: ut quos tuis réficis sacraméntis; intercedénte beáto Geórgio Mártyre tuo, tibi étiam plácitis móribus dignánter tríbuas deservíre: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

We humbly beseech You, almighty God, that those whom You refresh with Your sacraments may, at the intercession of blessed George, Your martyr, be graciously enabled to serve You also by a life pleasing to You; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Deus, qui beátum Ludovícum Maríam Confessórem tuum, Crucis mystérii et sanctíssimi Rosárii præcónem exímium effecísti; ac nova per eum família Ecclésiam fecundásti: ejus méritis et intercessióne concéde, ut per unigéniti Fílii tui vitam, mortem, ac resurrectiónem; salútis ætérnæ prǽmia consequámur: Per eúndem Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum Fílium tuum, qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

O God, who made blessed Louis Mary, Your confessor, an outstanding herald of the mystery of the Cross and of the most holy Rosary, and through him made Your Church fruitful with a new family; grant by his merits and intercession that through the life, death and resurrection of Your only-begotten Son we may obtain the rewards of eternal salvation; through the same Jesus Christ, Your Son, our Lord, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Oblatiónem nostram, quǽsumus Dómine, beátus Ludovícus María tibi reddat accéptam: qui se tibi hóstiam vivéntem ac placéntem júgiter immolávit. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

May blessed Louis Mary, we beseech You, O Lord, render our offering acceptable to You, he who ever offered himself to You as a living and well-pleasing victim; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Súmpsimus, Dómine, divínum sacraméntum, passiónis tuæ memoriále perpétuum: tríbue, quǽsumus, beáto Ludovíco María Confessóre tuo interveniénte, ut ad nostram salútem hoc munus profíciat; quod ineffábili nobis caritáte donásti: Qui vivis et regnas cum Deo Patre, in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

We have received, O Lord, the divine sacrament, the everlasting memorial of Your passion; grant, we beseech You, through the intercession of blessed Louis Mary, Your confessor, that this gift, which You have given us with unspeakable love, may profit us for salvation; who live and reign with God the Father, in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Deus, pro cujus amóre, ac fídei tuéndæ zelo, beáti Guillélmus et sócii gládiis impiórum occubuére: præsta, quǽsumus, ut eórum suffrágiis, in fide stábiles; te semper ex ánimo diligámus: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

O God, for love of whom and through zeal for defending the faith blessed William and his companions fell by the swords of the ungodly; grant, we beseech You, that by their prayers we may be steadfast in the faith and ever love You from our heart; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Sanctífica Dómine múnera in beatórum Guillélmi et sociórum festivitáte propósita: et sicut per hæc divína mystéria illis glóriam contulísti, ita nobis indulgéntiam tríbuas placátus, et pacem. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Sanctify, O Lord, the gifts offered to You on this feast of blessed William and his companions; and as You gave glory to them through these divine mysteries, so likewise, being appeased, bestow on us pardon and peace; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Súmpsimus, Dómine, ætérnæ vitæ sacraménta, te humíliter deprecántes: ut quorum mérita venerándo recólimus; fídei constántiam imitémur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Having received the sacraments of everlasting life, O Lord, we humbly pray that we may imitate the steadfast faith of those whose merits we reverently recall; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Osténdat te nobis, Dómine Jesu, post hoc exsílium, clemens et pia Virgo María Mater tua: quam beáti Sadócus et sócii inter hostíles infidélium ímpetus, incessánti voce salutántes; præoptátam martýrii palmam a te recípere meruérunt: Qui vivis et regnas cum Deo Patre, in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

After this our exile, O Lord Jesus, may the clement and loving Virgin Mary, Your Mother, show You to us; she whom blessed Sadoc and his companions, greeting her with unceasing voice amid the hostile onslaughts of the unbelievers, deserved to receive from You the palm of martyrdom which they longed for; who live and reign with God the Father, in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Véniam nobis, Dómine, et grátiam cónferat Agni occísi ab orígine mundi jugis hæc oblátio, ac imploráta eórum intercéssio, qui Regínam Mártyrum pio ritu salutántes, stolam in ejúsdem Agni Sánguine dealbáre meruérunt. Qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

May this perpetual offering of the Lamb slain from the beginning of the world bestow on us pardon and grace, O Lord, together with the prayers we implore of those who, greeting the Queen of Martyrs with devout rite, deserved to wash their robes in the Blood of the same Lamb; who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Mensa cæléstis, et celebráta solémnia ad salutárem nos, Dómine, éxcitent meditatiónem instántis judícii: ac Jesu benedícti, et Maríæ Vírginis Matris láudibus in finem usque inténtos; Mártyrum tuórum felicitátis fáciant sine fine consórtes: Per eúndem Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum Fílium tuum, qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

May the heavenly table and this solemnity we have celebrated rouse us, O Lord, to a saving meditation on the judgment at hand; and keeping us intent to the end on the praises of the blessed Jesus and of the Virgin Mary His Mother, may they make us sharers without end in the happiness of Your martyrs; through the same Jesus Christ, Your Son, our Lord, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Deus, qui beatíssimæ semper Vírginis et Genitrícis tuæ Maríæ singulári título Carméli Ordinem decorásti: concéde propítius, ut cujus hódie commemoratiónem solémni celebrámus offício: ejus muníti præsídiis, ad gáudia sempitérna perveníre mereámur: Qui vivis et regnas cum Deo Patre, in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

O God, who honored the Order of Carmel with the singular title of the most blessed Mary, ever Virgin, Your Mother; mercifully grant that, defended by the protection of her whose commemoration we celebrate today with solemn office, we may deserve to come to everlasting joys; who live and reign with God the Father, in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Unigéniti tui, Dómine, nobis succúrrat humánitas: ut qui natus de Vírgine, Matris integritátem non mínuit, sed sacrávit, in solemnitáte ejus, nostris nos piáculis éxuens, oblatiónem nostram tibi fáciat accéptam: Jesus Christus Dóminus noster, qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

May the humanity of Your only-begotten Son come to our aid, O Lord; that He who, born of the Virgin, did not lessen but hallowed His Mother's integrity, may on her feast free us from our sins and make our offering acceptable to You, Jesus Christ our Lord; who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Súmpsimus, Dómine, celebritátis ánnuæ votíva sacraménta; præsta quǽsumus, ut et temporális vitæ nobis remédia prǽbeant, et ætérnæ: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

We have received, O Lord, the votive sacraments of this yearly feast; grant, we beseech You, that they may bring us remedies both for this temporal life and for eternal life; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Sanctus Martyr tuus Gorgónius sua nos, Dómine, intercessióne lætíficet; et pia fáciat solemnitáte gaudére: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

May Your holy martyr Gorgonius gladden us, O Lord, by his intercession, and make us rejoice in his loving festival; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Grata tibi sit, Dómine, nostræ servitútis oblátio, pro qua sanctus Gorgónius Martyr intervéntor exsístat. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

May the offering of our service be pleasing to You, O Lord, and may Saint Gorgonius, Your martyr, plead for it; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Famíliam tuam, quǽsumus Dómine, propítius intuére: et intercedénte beáto Gorgónio Mártyre tuo; per hæc sancta, quæ súmpsimus, a cunctis éripe benígnus advérsis: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Look mercifully, we beseech You, O Lord, upon Your family, and at the intercession of blessed Gorgonius, Your martyr, through these holy things which we have received graciously deliver us from all adversities; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Beatórum Mártyrum tuórum Proti et Hyacínthi nos, Dómine, fóveat pretiósa conféssio; et pia júgiter intercéssio tueátur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

May the precious confession of Your blessed martyrs Protus and Hyacinth cherish us, O Lord, and their loving intercession ever protect us; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Pro sanctórum Mártyrum tuórum Proti et Hyacínthi commemoratióne, múnera tibi Dómine, quæ debémus, exsólvimus: præsta quǽsumus, ut remédium nobis perpétuæ salútis operéntur. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

In commemoration of Your holy martyrs Protus and Hyacinth we pay You, O Lord, the gifts we owe; grant, we beseech You, that they may work in us the remedy of everlasting salvation; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Ut percépta nos, Dómine, tua sancta puríficent; beatórum Mártyrum tuórum Proti et Hyacínthi, quǽsumus, implóret orátio: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

We beseech You, O Lord, that the prayer of Your blessed martyrs Protus and Hyacinth may obtain that the holy things we have received may cleanse us; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Deus, qui per gloriosíssimam Fílii tui Matrem, ad liberándos Christi fidéles a potestáte Paganórum, nova Ecclésiam tuam prole amplificáre dignátus es: præsta quǽsumus, ut quam pie venerámur tanti óperis institutrícem; ejus páriter méritis et intercessióne a peccátis ómnibus, et captivitáte dǽmonis liberémur: Per eúndem Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum Fílium tuum, qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

O God, who through the most glorious Mother of Your Son were pleased to enrich Your Church with a new offspring for the freeing of Christ's faithful from the power of the heathen; grant, we beseech You, that we who devoutly honor her as the foundress of so great a work may by her merits and intercession be likewise freed from all sins and from the captivity of the devil; through the same Jesus Christ, Your Son, our Lord, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Unigéniti tui, Dómine, nobis succúrrat humánitas: ut qui natus de Vírgine, Matris integritátem non mínuit, sed sacrávit, in solemnitáte ejus, nostris nos piáculis éxuens, oblatiónem nostram tibi fáciat accéptam: Jesus Christus Dóminus noster, qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

May the humanity of Your only-begotten Son come to our aid, O Lord; that He who, born of the Virgin, did not lessen but hallowed His Mother's integrity, may on her feast free us from our sins and make our offering acceptable to You, Jesus Christ our Lord; who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Súmpsimus, Dómine, celebritátis ánnuæ votíva sacraménta; præsta quǽsumus, ut et temporális vitæ nobis remédia prǽbeant, et ætérnæ: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

We have received, O Lord, the votive sacraments of this yearly feast; grant, we beseech You, that they may bring us remedies both for this temporal life and for eternal life; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Da, quǽsumus omnípotens Deus: ut beáti Remígii Confessóris tui atque Pontíficis veneránda solémnitas; et devotiónem nobis áugeat, et salútem: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that the venerable feast of blessed Remigius, Your confessor and bishop, may increase in us both devotion and salvation; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Sancti tui, quǽsumus Dómine, nos ubíque lætíficent: ut dum eórum mérita recólimus, patrocínia sentiámus. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Let Your saints, O Lord, everywhere make us glad; that while we remember their merits we may experience their help; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Præsta, quǽsumus omnípotens Deus: ut de percéptis munéribus grátias exhibéntes; intercedénte beáto Remígio Confessóre tuo atque Pontífice, benefícia potióra sumámus: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that giving thanks for the gifts received, we may, through the intercession of blessed Remigius, Your confessor and bishop, obtain still greater benefits; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Deus, qui beátum Joánnem mirábili prudéntia et fortitúdine claréscere voluísti; ipso interveniénte, concéde ut família tua semper et ubíque salúbri regímine gubernétur. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

O God, who willed that blessed John should shine with wonderful prudence and fortitude; grant through his intercession that Your family may always and everywhere be governed by a salutary rule; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Oblátis Dómine placáre munéribus; et intercedénte beáto Joánne, déxteram tuam in Ecclésiæ subsídium cleménter exténde: ut destrúctis adversitátibus et erróribus univérsis, fídei unitáte et pacis abundántia lætétur. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Be appeased, O Lord, by the gifts we offer; and at the intercession of blessed John mercifully stretch forth Your right hand in aid of Your Church, that all adversities and errors being destroyed, she may rejoice in unity of faith and abundance of peace; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Sacris dápibus refécti, tibi Dómine grátias persólvimus: tuam misericórdiam deprecántes, ut méritis et intercessióne beáti Joánnis a peccatórum néxibus absolúti; ad cæléstem pátriam per sémitas perfectiónis contendámus. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Refreshed by this sacred banquet, O Lord, we give You thanks, imploring Your mercy that, loosed from the bonds of sin through the merits and intercession of blessed John, we may press on to our heavenly home along the paths of perfection; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Deus, qui Ecclésiam tuam beáti Domínici Confessóris tui præcláris vitæ méritis decorásti; et in liberándis captívis, gloriósis lætificásti miráculis: concéde nobis fámulis tuis, ut et ipsíus instruámur exémplis; et ab omni vitiórum servitúte ejus patrocínio liberémur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

O God, who adorned Your Church with the illustrious merits of the life of blessed Dominic, Your confessor, and gladdened her with glorious miracles in the freeing of captives; grant to us Your servants that we may be instructed by his example and freed by his patronage from all bondage to vice; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Sacris altáribus, Dómine, hóstias superpósitas sanctus Domínicus Abbas, quǽsumus, in salútem nobis proveníre depóscat. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

May Saint Dominic the Abbot, we beseech You, O Lord, obtain that the victims laid upon Your holy altars may further our salvation; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Prótegat nos, Dómine, cum tui perceptióne sacraménti, beátus Domínicus Abbas, pro nobis intercedéndo: ut et conversatiónis ejus experiámur insígnia; et intercessiónis ipsíus percipiámus suffrágia: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

May blessed Dominic the Abbot, interceding for us, protect us, O Lord, together with the reception of Your sacrament, that we may both experience the excellence of his way of life and receive the help of his intercession; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Deus, qui sub beatíssimæ Vírginis Maríæ singulári Patrocínio Ordinem Prædicatórum ad animárum salútem institúi; ejúsque perpétuis benefíciis cumulári voluísti: præsta supplícibus tuis, ut cujus hódie commemoratiónem cólimus; illíus protécti auxíliis ad cæléstem glóriam perducámur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

O God, who willed that the Order of Preachers should be founded for the salvation of souls under the singular patronage of the most blessed Virgin Mary, and be laden with her unceasing benefits; grant to Your suppliants that, protected by the help of her whose commemoration we keep today, we may be brought to heavenly glory; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Unigéniti tui, Dómine, nobis succúrrat humánitas: ut qui natus de Vírgine, Matris integritátem non mínuit, sed sacrávit, in solemnitáte ejus nostris nos piáculis éxuens, oblatiónem nostram tibi fáciat accéptam: Jesus Christus Dóminus noster, qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

May the humanity of Your only-begotten Son come to our aid, O Lord; that He who, born of the Virgin, did not lessen but hallowed His Mother's integrity, may on her feast free us from our sins and make our offering acceptable to You, Jesus Christ our Lord; who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Súmpsimus, Dómine, celebritátis ánnuæ votíva sacraménta; præsta quǽsumus, ut et temporális vitæ nobis remédia prǽbeant, et ætérnæ: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

We have received, O Lord, the votive sacraments of this yearly feast; grant, we beseech You, that they may bring us remedies both for this temporal life and for eternal life; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Intercéssio nos, quǽsumus Dómine, beáti Benedícti Abbátis comméndet: ut quod nostris méritis non valémus; ejus patrocínio assequámur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

May the intercession of blessed Benedict the Abbot, we beseech You, O Lord, commend us to You, that what we cannot obtain by our own merits we may obtain by his patronage; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Sacris altáribus, Dómine, hóstias superpósitas sanctus Benedíctus Abbas, quǽsumus, in salútem nobis proveníre depóscat. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

May Saint Benedict the Abbot, we beseech You, O Lord, obtain that the victims laid upon Your holy altars may further our salvation; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Prótegat nos, Dómine, cum tui perceptióne sacraménti, beátus Benedíctus Abbas, pro nobis intercedéndo: ut et conversatiónis ejus experiámur insígnia; et intercessiónis ipsíus percipiámus suffrágia: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

or: Intercéssio nos, quǽsumus Dómine, beáti Ægídii Abbátis comméndet: ut quod nostris méritis non valémus; ejus patrocínio assequámur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

se: Sacris altáribus, Dómine, hóstias superpósitas sanctus Ægídius Abbas, quǽsumus, in salútem nobis proveníre depóscat. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

May Saint Giles the Abbot, we beseech You, O Lord, obtain that the victims laid upon Your holy altars may further our salvation; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Exáudi nos Deus salutáris noster: ut sicut de beátæ Praxédis Vírginis tuæ festivitáte gaudémus; ita piæ devotiónis erudiámur afféctu: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Hear us, O God our Saviour, that as we rejoice in the feast of blessed Praxedes, Your virgin, so we may be taught the spirit of loving devotion; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Accépta tibi sit, Dómine, sacrátæ plebis oblátio pro tuórum honóre Sanctórum, quorum se méritis de tribulatióne percepísse cognóscit auxílium. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

May the offering of Your consecrated people be acceptable to You, O Lord, in honor of Your saints, through whose merits they acknowledge that they have received help in tribulation; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Satiásti Dómine famíliam tuam munéribus sacris: ejus, quǽsumus, semper interventióne nos réfove; cujus solémnia celebrámus: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

You have filled Your household, O Lord, with sacred gifts; ever refresh us, we beseech You, by the intercession of her whose feast we celebrate; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
